Metal tools are the historically decisive subclass; metallurgy provides the material medium for precision and durability.
Metal plowshares, sickles, and threshing tools extended agriculture beyond hand-tools; metallurgy enabled the scale and efficiency of plow agriculture.

Agricultural knowledge - planting calendars, seed names, irrigation methods, seasonal rhythms - is transmitted through language. Oral tradition and written records both carry the technical vocabulary of husbandry.

Record-keeping for crop yields, land area, seed quantities, and seasonal timing requires counting, measurement, and arithmetic. The earliest writing systems (cuneiform tally marks) were invented for agricultural accounting.
Algorithms require notation to be captured and transmitted. Writing detaches procedure from memory and lets it persist across instances. Which-came-first: writing predates formal algorithms.

The earliest algorithms (Babylonian arithmetic, Egyptian fractions) operate over numbers. Number predates algorithmic procedures but algorithms as structured procedures require number as their domain.
Computers are physical instantiations of algorithm execution. Which-came-first: algorithms predate computers by millennia.
Protocols are a class of algorithms — explicitly shared stepwise procedures for message exchange. Which-came-first: algorithms are more general and older.

A market-order is a single transaction within the market framework. Market came first — many orders make a market. Which-came-first: market is the broader construct.

Patents are creatures of law — sovereign grants of exclusion. Which-came-first: law predates patents.
Patents involve an agreement: disclosure in exchange for exclusivity. Which-came-first: contract predates patents.

Software licenses grant rights derived from patents/copyrights. The license is the instrument, the patent is the right. Which-came-first: patent predates software-license (the concept of patent predates software).
Patent is a specific type of legal construct. Which-came-first: law is more general and older.
Money (abstract medium of exchange) existed first; currency is the specific instantiation with issuing authority, denominations, and legal tender status. which-came-first: money predates currency.

Tradition requires language for intergenerational transmission. which-came-first: language predates feudal-obligation traditions.
Feudal-obligation is a specific tradition — a pattern of behavior transmitted intergenerationally through enactment.

The dependency is constitutive, not merely facilitative: algorithmic-governance requires algorithms running now to function.

Quantum ethics is a branch of ethics concerned with moral questions arising from quantum technology. It needs ethics as its conceptual foundation — remove ethics and quantum ethics ceases to be a meaningful discipline.

Legitimacy is the quality of being recognized as rightful or justified. It depends on authority — legitimacy is the social recognition of authority. Without authority, there is nothing to be legitimate about.

Jurisprudence is the systematic study and philosophy of law. Without law as its object of study, jurisprudence cannot exist — it is constitutively dependent on law. Test: remove law, and jurisprudence has nothing to analyze.

Testing direction: which came first? Abstraction as a cognitive capacity predates formal models; but DEPENDS_ON asks: remove abstraction now, does modeling stop? Yes — a model is by definition an abstract representation. Remove the capacity for abstraction and models cannot operate. This is present-tense necessity, not just chronology.

boundary-work needs taxonomic classification systems to operate now — without categories to draw boundaries between, boundary-work has no material to work on. This is constitutive, not merely facilitative.

Cognitive maps — the internal representations of spatial and conceptual relationships — are structured and maintained through language. Language provides the symbolic scaffolding that makes cognitive mapping possible; without language, there is no structured representation of relationships. This is constitutive: remove language and the cognitive map as a human-made construct collapses.

A schema is a structured framework for organizing information. Schemas are inherently linguistic constructs — they consist of slots, values, and relationships that are articulated through language. Remove language and the schema ceases to exist as a human-made structure. This is constitutive, not merely facilitative.

Legitimacy is the status conferred by collective recognition and acceptance. This recognition is constitutively conventional: without shared norms and collective practices (convention), legitimacy cannot operate. Remove convention and the mechanism of collective acceptance vanishes — legitimacy ceases to function.

Quantum-safe cryptography is entirely built on mathematical constructs — lattice problems, code-based hardness assumptions, multivariate equations. Its security proofs ARE mathematical theorems. Remove mathematics and quantum-safe cryptography ceases to exist as a discipline; there is no framework for defining or proving security. This is constitutive, not merely facilitative.

Generalization requires inference to operate — you cannot generalize from instances to categories without the inferential leap. Remove inference (inductive reasoning) and generalization ceases to function.

Explanation requires reasoning to operate — you cannot produce an explanation (making something intelligible) without the reasoning process that connects premises to conclusions. Remove reasoning and explanation becomes mere description.

Falsification as a method depends on science — it is the criterion of demarcation operating within the scientific enterprise. Remove science (the practice of testing claims against evidence) and falsification has no domain in which to operate.

Quantum sound is the formal study of sound through quantum mechanical formalism, which is fundamentally mathematical. Mathematics is not merely facilitative but constitutive — quantum sound theory cannot exist without the mathematical framework that defines it. The wavefunctions, operators, and Hilbert spaces are the substance of the construct, not just tools to describe it.

An election is a structured process for collective decision-making through voting. Vote is constitutive: remove the mechanism of voting and the election ceases to exist. This is not historical association but present-tense necessity — elections cannot operate without voting.

A model requires conceptualization of its domain — you cannot construct a model without first forming conceptual representations of the elements and their relations. Remove conceptualization (the cognitive capacity to form concepts) and model-building stops immediately.

Cognitive-architecture (the human practice of deliberately structuring mental frameworks, categories, and knowledge systems) requires taxonomy to operate. Taxonomy provides the categorization apparatus that cognitive-architecture uses to organize mental structures. Remove taxonomy — the practice of systematic classification — and cognitive-architecture has no tool to build with. This is constitutive, not merely facilitative (Law 8/8a): taxonomy is the conceptual substrate without which cognitive-architecture cannot function in the present tense.

Quantum computing requires measurement as a constitutive substrate: the entire operational logic of quantum computation — state preparation, gate operation, and readout — is measurement. Without the concept and practice of measurement, quantum computing cannot function. This is not historical chronology but present-tense necessity.

A schema is an organized pattern for processing information — it operates by classifying entities into categories. Remove classification (the practice of sorting into kinds) and schemas lose their mechanism. Present-tense necessity.

Representation requires symbols — signs that stand for something else. Without symbols there is no medium through which to represent. Remove symbols and representation as a human practice cannot operate.

Schema is a structured system of categories, concepts, and their interrelationships. It needs language as its constitutive substrate — without language, there can be no schema to express, store, or propagate categories and relationships. Language is not merely facilitative here; it is the medium in which schema exists and operates.

Classification as a systematic practice — organizing entities into named categories with rules — depends on language as its constitutive substrate. Without language, there is no way to express categories, communicate boundaries, or persist a classification system. Language is the medium through which classification operates and endures.

Quantum computing depends on measurement as a constitutive operation: the collapse of quantum states through measurement is not merely a step in the process — it is the mechanism by which quantum information becomes classical output. Without measurement, quantum computing cannot produce any result. This is present-tense necessity, not historical chronology.

Cognitive architecture — the organized structure of mental processes and representations — fundamentally depends on schemas as its building blocks. Schemas are the reusable cognitive structures that populate and operate within any cognitive architecture. Remove schemas and the architecture has no content to organize.

A perspective requires interpretation to give it content — the standpoint only functions as a perspective through the interpretive framework that selects what is salient. Remove interpretation and the standpoint collapses into raw, unoriented perception.

Categorization as a human practice depends on language to operate now. Language is the medium through which categories are expressed, stabilized, and shared — without language, categorization cannot function as a human-made practice (only as a pre-linguistic pattern-recognition faculty, which is territory, not map). This is constitutive: the concept of categorization in the made world is inseparable from the linguistic tools that make it persist.

Epistemology needs logic to operate now — without logical structure (valid inference, non-contradiction, sound reasoning), epistemological evaluation of knowledge claims cannot function. This is present-tense necessity, not just historical association.

Taxonomy is the systematic practice of categorizing entities into hierarchical classes. Remove categorization as a cognitive practice and taxonomy ceases to operate — taxonomy IS formalized categorization. This is constitutive, not facilitative.
Heuristic is a specific kind of problem-solving strategy — one that trades optimality for tractability. A heuristic IS a strategy (specific→general). Strategy is the general category.

Direction tested: DEPENDS_ON. Constitutive test: remove language and trademark cannot function — a trademark is a sign that communicates brand identity through shared symbolic meaning; without the semiotic substrate of language, it is just a mark, not a trademark. Present-tense necessity: the legal concept of trademark relies on language-based classification, description, and communication.
Test: which came first? Symbol is more general and older. Trademark is a specific kind of symbol used for source-identification. 'Trademark is a kind of symbol' is always INSTANCE_OF.
Digital ledger needs writing to operate now — remove writing and ledgers (the practice of recording) cannot exist. Writing is the constitutive substrate.

Allegory depends on metaphor as its constitutive mechanism: remove metaphor and allegory cannot operate — it works by sustained metaphoric substitution mapping one domain onto another. This is present-tense necessity, not mere association.

Classification IS structured categorization — the systematic application of categorization to organize entities into named groups. Without categorization (the cognitive act of grouping by shared features), classification cannot operate. Constitutive dependency.

A rubric is an evaluation framework built from criteria categories with performance descriptors. Remove categorization and a rubric loses its ability to organize criteria into distinct types — the dependency is constitutive, not merely facilitative.

Navigation depends on cognitive mapping: remove the capacity to form mental maps of spatial relationships and complex navigation stops working. You can only shuffle randomly or follow fixed paths without a cognitive representation of the territory. Constitutive, not merely facilitative.

A library depends on shelves for systematic organization. Remove shelves and the library cannot maintain ordered, browsable access to its collection — it becomes a pile of materials rather than an organized institution. Shelves are constitutive to the library as a structured access system, not merely facilitative.
emblem INSTANCE_OF symbol. An emblem is a specific kind of symbol — a mark or device that represents a group, organization, or idea. 'Emblem is a specific type of symbol' follows Law 9.

Choreography (from Greek choreia 'dance' + graphia 'writing') is constitutively dependent on notation: it IS the notated recording of movement sequences. Remove notation and choreography — the practice of systematically encoding movement — cannot exist.

Indexing is constitutively dependent on categorization: an index organizes items by grouping them into categories for retrieval. Remove categorization — the very operation of grouping — and indexing cannot function. This is present-tense necessity, not mere association.

A rubric is a specific kind of standard — namely, an evaluation standard that specifies criteria and performance levels. 'Rubric is a specific kind of standard' matches the INSTANCE_OF direction: specific→general.
trademark is a specific kind of credential: it credentials the origin and authenticity of goods/services. INSTANCE_OF maps specific→general (trademark→credential). Law 9.

Knowledge-representation requires language to operate now. Language is the substrate through which knowledge is encoded, communicated, and stored in human-made systems. Without language (in its broadest sense including writing, symbols, and formal notations), knowledge-representation as a practice cannot function. This is a present-tense dependency: language is a near-universal substrate, and the dependency is constitutive, not merely facilitative.

Provenance IS the documented record of origin, custody, and transfer. Remove records and provenance ceases to exist — there is no provenance without a record to carry it. Constitutive dependency, not historical association.

A warrant (search warrant, marriage warrant, bench warrant) is a specific type of credential: a document or authorization issued by a competent authority to prove legal permission or right. INSTANCE_OF maps specific→general per Law 9.

An interface IS the structured affordances it presents. Remove affordances (perceived possibilities for action) and the interface ceases to function — users cannot perceive what to do. This is present-tense constitutive necessity, not mere facilitation.

Sensemaking operates by imposing categories on experience. Remove categorization and sensemaking has no mechanism to distinguish, classify, or structure information. Present-tense constitutive dependency.

An edict IS a specific kind of mandate: both are authoritative directives, but an edict is specifically a formal decree issued unilaterally by a sovereign or authority, whereas a mandate is a broader category encompassing any authorization to act. Specific→general mapping: edict→mandate is INSTANCE_OF.

Algorithmic-governance requires a glossary to operate now: automated governance systems need formally defined terms and unambiguous terminology to function. Without a shared glossary of definitions, algorithmic rules cannot be precisely specified, interpreted, or enforced consistently. The glossary is constitutive of algorithmic-governance — it is not merely facilitative but necessary for the practice to function.

Navigation requires perceiving and interpreting affordances — the possibilities for action that an environment offers. Remove affordances and navigation stops working: without perceived action possibilities, there is nothing to navigate toward or through.

Codification needs code to operate: the process of systematizing rules produces a code (a structured body of rules). Without the concept of a code as its output, codification has no purpose or mechanism. Constitutive dependency.

Knowledge-representation requires codification to operate now: structured knowledge cannot be represented without some form of coding system — encoding information into a representable format. Without codification, knowledge cannot be externalized or transmitted.

Audit is the systematic examination of records. Remove records entirely and the practice of auditing has nothing to examine — it ceases to operate. The dependency is present-tense and constitutive, not merely historical or facilitative.

Certification is the formal verification that something meets a standard. Remove standards and certification has no criteria to verify against — the practice is eliminated. This is a constitutive, present-tense dependency, not merely facilitative.

A glossary is a codified list of terms with definitions. Remove codification — the practice of systematically recording and formalizing knowledge — and the glossary has no mechanism to persist its entries. The dependency is constitutive: without codification there is no glossary, only oral vocabulary.

Storytelling requires language to construct and transmit narratives. Remove language entirely and storytelling collapses — no spoken, written, or signed language means no storytelling mechanism. This is CONSTITUTIVE, present-tense necessity.
Codification needs law to operate now — removing the law construct and codification stops being meaningful. Law provides the framework within which codification operates as a practice.

Compliance needs standards to exist right now — remove the practice of setting standards and compliance has nothing to comply with. The dependency is present-tense and constitutive, not merely historical.

A digital ledger needs records to exist right now — remove the concept of a record and the digital ledger has nothing to digitize. The dependency is constitutive: without records, there is nothing for a digital ledger to be.

Attribution is the practice of naming an originator — it needs records to operate now. Without the ability to record who did what, attribution collapses. A name without a record of its holder cannot be attributed.
Attribution requires language to name the originator. Remove language and you cannot express who created what — the act of attributing vanishes with the capacity for symbolic reference.
An affidavit is a sworn written statement with legal force. It depends on law for its meaning and function — remove the legal system and an affidavit loses all purpose and effect.
Imprimatur is official authorization or sanction (literally 'let it be printed'). It requires authority to grant it — without authority there can be no imprimatur.

Affordance requires cognition to operate: an affordance is not a bare physical property but the perceived action potential between environment and agent. Remove cognition — the capacity to perceive, interpret, and recognize what the environment offers — and the concept of affordance has no operational meaning. Present-tense dependency: you cannot engage with or utilize an affordance without cognitive processing.

A glossary IS a structured list of terms with definitions. It requires a record (the practice of systematically recording and formalizing knowledge) to exist — without records there is no glossary. The dependency is constitutive.

dogma DEPENDS_ON authority: a dogma is a principle or belief accepted as authoritative and beyond challenge. Without an authority that establishes and enforces its authority, dogma collapses into mere opinion. The dependency is present-tense and constitutive.

Codification is the practice of collecting, organizing, and systematizing rules or knowledge into a formal code. It needs record to operate now — without a persistent recording mechanism, there is no codification, only scattered practices. This is constitutive, not merely facilitative.

Verification is the present-tense practice of confirming accuracy or truth by checking against a recorded standard, log, or archive. Remove records — the persistent human-made artifacts that serve as the reference — and verification ceases to operate: there is no basis against which to check. The dependency is constitutive, not merely facilitative.

systema_constructum_v2 cannot operate without hermeneutics: the entire game requires interpreting concepts, drawing meaning between constructs, and making sense of the taxonomy. Removing hermeneutic capacity would stop all game operations — interpretation is the constitutive engine, not merely a tool.

An icon is a specific kind of symbol — one that operates through resemblance to its referent. Symbol is the general category of representation-by-convention; icon is the specific subtype that uses structural similarity. Direction: specific→general per Law 9.

nomenclature requires language to function — naming systems are built from words, labels, and semantic structures. Remove language and naming ceases to exist. This is a present-tense dependency, not historical chronology.

A decree is a specific kind of edict — a formal proclamation issued by an executive or sovereign authority. Edict is the general category of authoritative pronouncements; decree is the specific subtype tied to executive power. Direction: specific→general per Law 9.
An icon is a specific kind of mental model — a visual representation that stands for something in the mind. The icon IS a case of the broader category of mental model (specific→general).

Framing is a specific kind of mental model — it is the cognitive structure through which one approaches and interprets a situation. The specific (how you frame a problem) is a case of the general (a cognitive framework for understanding).

Accountability requires verification to operate now — removing verification (the ability to check whether actions match standards) makes accountability impossible. You cannot hold an agent accountable if there is no mechanism to verify outcomes against expectations. This is a constitutive dependency (Law 8/8a), not merely historical.
Dogma requires language to express, transmit, and sustain beliefs. Remove language entirely and dogma cannot exist — it is the medium through which dogmatic content is articulated and transmitted.
Typology is a specific systematic classification scheme — a method of organizing things into types and categories. It is a particular kind of categorization, not a whole-part or dependency relation.

Hermeneutics is the theory and practice of interpretation. It needs language to operate now — interpretation acts on linguistic texts, and without language there is nothing to interpret. Remove language and hermeneutics ceases to function.

Semantics is the study of meaning, and meaning requires syntactic structure to attach to — word order, grammatical roles, hierarchical constituents. Remove syntax and meaning has no scaffold to inhabit; semantics ceases to operate.

Authorization is the delegation or grant of authority — the power to command, decide, or bind. You cannot delegate what does not exist. Authority is the constitutive substrate of authorization; remove it and authorization has nothing to distribute.

Hermeneutics (interpretation theory) requires semantics (meaning) to operate — interpretation operates on meaning. Remove semantics and hermeneutics has nothing to interpret. The dependency is constitutive.
An archetype is a universally recognized symbolic pattern — a specific kind of symbol that carries deep cross-cultural meaning. Archetype is a specific case of the general category symbol.

Mnemonics are techniques and strategies for improving recall; they operate by structuring information to leverage memory mechanisms. Remove memory and mnemonics cease to function — they are constitutively dependent on memory systems.

A catalog is an organized list or collection of items. It depends on taxonomy for its structure — without taxonomic classification (categorization hierarchy), a catalog has no organizational framework to work with. Remove taxonomy and the catalog loses its ability to organize systematically.

Oversight requires verification to operate — you cannot oversee without checking, confirming, or validating. Remove verification and oversight ceases to function: there is no mechanism to confirm what is being overseen. This is present-tense constitutive dependency, not historical.

Remove authority right now — does accreditation stop working? Yes. Accreditation is the granting of recognized qualification by an authority; without an authority to grant it, the practice vanishes. The dependency is present-tense and constitutive, not merely historical or facilitative.

Remove abstraction — does the paradigm stop working? Yes. A paradigm is an abstract framework or pattern that organizes thought and practice. Without the capacity for abstraction, no paradigm can exist. This is constitutive: paradigms are made entirely of abstracted patterns.
a bylaw is a specific kind of law — internal rules made by an organization for its members, distinct from statutory/public law but sharing the same legal character.

Citation requires verification to function: you must be able to verify the truth of a cited claim for the citation to serve its purpose. Remove verification and citations lose their epistemic function.
Citation depends on notation systems to encode and transmit references. Without a notation mechanism (written, symbolic, or encoded), citation as a practice cannot exist.

folklore needs language to operate — it is a body of cultural knowledge (stories, beliefs, practices) that exists only through linguistic transmission. Without language, the construct of folklore cannot persist or function. DEPENDS_ON is constitutive here, not merely facilitative.

Ratification requires legal authority to give acts force — remove law and ratification loses its operative power. Present-tense necessity: ratification is a legal act that depends on the legal system operating now (Law 8).
template as a form requiring language to express its structure — templates need language to function; without language there can be no template

Euphemism is a linguistic substitution device — it exists only within language, as a pattern of speech/writing. Remove language and euphemism ceases to operate; the dependency is present-tense and constitutive, not merely facilitative.
A writ is a specific type of legal instrument — a formal written order issued by legal authority. INSTANCE_OF follows the specific→general rule: writ is a kind of law (legal document).

A signifier only functions when interpreted. Without hermeneutics — the theory and practice of interpretation — a signifier is just a mark. The signifier constitutively depends on interpretive frameworks to become meaningful.
Ratification is a specific legal process within the broader category of law. It is a formal approval procedure that operates as a sub-type of legal mechanism — a particular kind of legal act.

Remove language — the shared symbolic system through which the seal's physical mark is interpreted as an authentication signal — and the seal ceases to function as authentication; it becomes merely an impression with no communicative content. The dependency is present-tense: a seal operates as a sign only within a linguistic/cultural framework that grants it meaning.

Remove authority — the institutional or personal power that gives a seal its force as authentication — and the seal becomes merely a mark with no certifying power. A seal's entire function is to manifest the authority of its possessor; without recognized authority, it is inert. This is present-tense necessity: the seal operates as authentication only because authority operates alongside it.

Notation systems (musical, mathematical, symbolic) depend on language as their substrate — they are formalized extensions of linguistic convention. Remove language and notation loses its meaning-making capacity.

testimony is a formal spoken or written account given under oath. It depends on language constitutively — without language as the medium, testimony cannot exist. The concept, form, and transmission of testimony all require language to operate.

Curse is a formal utterance invoking harm or misfortune. It is constitutively dependent on language: remove language and a curse cannot be formulated, uttered, or understood — it becomes mere noise or gesture. Language provides the symbolic system that makes a curse a speech-act rather than a physical action.
Gossip requires language to operate now — it is a form of verbal/social information transfer. Without language as a substrate, the practice of gossiping cannot exist. This is constitutive.

subpoena is a specific type of writ — a subpoena IS a writ that compels appearance or production. 'X is a specific kind of Y' maps to INSTANCE_OF (Law 9). Direction: specific (subpoena) → general (writ).

An injunction is a specific type of writ — both are formal written court orders. A writ is the general category of formal judicial commands; an injunction specifically commands a party to do or refrain from doing a specific act. This follows the precedent of subpoena INSTANCE_OF writ.

A signifier only functions when interpreted. Without hermeneutics — the framework for interpretation — a signifier is inert. Per Law 8: remove hermeneutics and the signifier ceases to function as a signifier. This is present-tense necessity, not chronology.

Persuasion requires language to operate — it is the structured use of symbols to influence belief or action. Without language (broadly conceived as any symbolic communication system), persuasion as a human-made construct ceases to function. This is present-tense constitutive necessity, not mere historical association.

Remove authority and ratification cannot function: ratification is the act of conferring formal validity, which requires an authority to recognize it. Present-tense dependency (Law 8). Ratification IS authority in action.

Remove language and a checklist ceases to function: checklists use language to encode items, sequences, and criteria. The dependency is present-tense — a checklist cannot operate without linguistic encoding (Law 8).

Delegation is the act of assigning responsibility or power to another agent. It constitutively depends on authority — you can only delegate what authority you hold, and the delegatee's power flows from that authority. Remove authority and delegation ceases to function.

A checklist requires writing to persist as a list of items to verify. Without writing, there can be no checklist — the entire mechanism of inscribed items for verification is constitutively dependent on the practice of writing.
Stare decisis is the doctrine of following precedent. Remove law as a system and stare decisis cannot operate — it is a constitutive rule internal to legal reasoning, not merely associated with law.
constitutive dependency: jurisdiction IS the legal concept of territorial authority — remove law and jurisdiction ceases to have any meaning or function. It cannot exist without law operating now.

Quorum is the minimum number of members required for a body to conduct business. It depends on authority because authority defines who counts as members and validates the quorum determination. Remove authority and quorum becomes an arbitrary count with no binding force.

Scaffolding is a temporary support structure built to enable work that cannot otherwise be done. It depends on authority because authority determines what scaffolding is needed, who builds it, and where it stands. Remove authority and scaffolding has no purpose or right to exist.

Testimony (oral or written statement) existed first as a broad concept; deposition (formalized testimony given under oath, recorded) came later as a specific legal procedure that evolved from it. Historical direction: which-came-first test.

An affidavit needs an oath to function — the oath is constitutive, not merely facilitative. Without the sworn declaration under penalty of perjury, the document is just a statement, not an affidavit. Remove the oath and the affidavit stops working as an evidentiary instrument.

A grievance is a formal complaint articulated through language. Remove shared symbolic systems (language) and the concept of lodging a grievance ceases to exist — no articulated grievance can be made. This is constitutive, not merely facilitative.

A subpoena is an authoritative legal order compelling appearance or testimony. Remove law — the institutional framework of authority and compulsion — and a subpoena becomes merely a piece of paper with words. The dependency is constitutive.

A quorum is the minimum number of members required to conduct business. Remove the capacity for numerical quantification (number) and the concept of a quorum ceases to function — it cannot specify 'minimum number' without number. This is a constitutive dependency, not merely facilitative.

Estoppel constitutively depends on law — it is a legal doctrine that prevents a party from asserting a claim contrary to prior representations or conduct. Remove law and estoppel ceases to function; the doctrine exists solely within legal systems to enforce consistency in judicial proceedings. This is present-tense constitutive necessity, not historical association.

Litotes is a rhetorical figure of understatement achieved through double negation (e.g. not bad instead of good). It is a linguistic pattern — its form IS its content. Remove language and the rhetorical device cannot exist at all. This is constitutive, not merely facilitative: litotes does not just use language as a medium; it is constituted by a specific structure within language.

Curation is the practice of selecting, organizing, and caring for a collection based on some scheme. It requires classification (categorization into meaningful groups) to operate right now — without categories to sort into and select from, curation cannot function. This is present-tense constitutive necessity, not historical association.

Genre is a classificatory concept within language and culture — a category of artistic or literary composition defined by shared conventions, forms, and expectations. These conventions exist and operate through language: naming, describing, teaching, and debating genres is a linguistic activity. Remove language and genre ceases to function as a concept. This is constitutive, not facilitative: like litotes→language, the entity IS a linguistic construct.

A syllogism is a formal logical structure requiring language to operate — premises, conclusions, and the inference between them are linguistic constructs. Remove language and syllogistic reasoning cannot exist or persist.

Rumour is information spread informally through language networks. Without language, rumour cannot exist as a mechanism — it has no medium of transmission. The dependency is present-tense and constitutive.

A checklist artifact depends on writing to exist — without a recording medium (written marks), there is no physical or digital checklist. The cognitive act of remembering requires no writing, but the CHECKLIST as a tool requires written notation.

Choreography as a codified art of structured movement derives from ritual practices. Ritual movement patterns (dance, processions, ceremonial gestures) existed millennia before choreography was recognized as a distinct art form. History: which-came-first test — ritual predates choreography.

A topos (topos/topoi) is a classical rhetorical concept — a commonplace, standard argumentative pattern or theme. It is inherently linguistic: a topos cannot exist without language because it IS a linguistic pattern of reasoning. Remove language and the topos ceases to operate. Constitutive dependency under Law 8, not mere facilitation.

Remove language — does fallacy stop working? Yes. A fallacy is a defect in reasoning as expressed through language; without language there is no structure for the error to inhabit. This is present-tense constitutive necessity, not mere association.

Irony requires a channel where surface meaning diverges from intended meaning. Without communication, there is no medium for that divergence to be registered. Remove communication right now and irony cannot operate — it is constitutively dependent on a communicative channel to exist as a figure or technique.

Irony is a semantic phenomenon that requires language to function. The gap between literal expression and intended meaning only exists through a symbolic system of language — remove language and the very mechanism that creates ironic effect vanishes. This is constitutive dependency: irony cannot operate without its linguistic substrate.

Parody is a specific kind of satire — both use humor to criticize, but parody targets a specific work while satire targets broader social faults. Direction: parody INSTANCE_OF satire is specific→general.
Parody is a fundamentally linguistic device — it requires language to create the imitation-critique pattern. Remove language and parody cannot operate at all.
Analogy is a cognitive-linguistic mapping device — it constructs parallelisms between domains through language. Without language, analogy as a structured comparison cannot function.
grammar is the system of rules that structures language — remove language entirely and grammar has nothing to govern. The rule-system needs its medium to operate now, not merely historically.

Genre is a specific type of taxonomy — namely, a classification system organized around shared characteristics of creative works (literary, musical, visual). The specific-to-general direction is clear: genre is a kind of taxonomy applied to cultural production.
Arraignment is a formal legal procedure in a judicial system. Remove law and the concept of arraignment ceases to operate — it is constitutively dependent on the legal framework that defines it.

Dialectic is a method of examination through dialogue and counter-argument. Remove argument and dialectic ceases to operate — it needs argument to function as a procedure. Present-tense constitutive necessity.

A compact is a formal binding agreement — its function as a compact (legally enforceable pact) requires the legal framework of law. Remove law and the compact loses its binding force and ceases to operate as a compact.

Deduction requires logic to operate now: without a logical system (rules of inference, validity criteria), the process of deriving specific conclusions from general premises cannot function. Deduction IS a logical operation — logic is its constitutive substrate.

An enthymeme is a rhetorical argument that omits a premise, expressed in natural language. It requires language to operate — the missing premise is supplied by the audience through linguistic inference. Remove language and the enthymeme ceases to function as an argument form.
Analogy is a cognitive and rhetorical device that maps properties across domains — it IS fundamentally a linguistic construct. Without language, analogy cannot function or be communicated.

Heuristics are mental shortcuts for decision-making under uncertainty. They are cognitive processes — if you remove cognition entirely, heuristics cannot operate. This is present-tense constitutive necessity, not merely facilitative.

Falsifiability is Popper's criterion for demarcating scientific from non-scientific claims. Without science, the concept of falsifiability has no referent — it exists specifically as a property of scientific hypotheses. Remove science and falsifiability ceases to be meaningful. Present-tense constitutive dependency.

An appeal is a legal procedure that challenges a prior decision. Remove law and there is no decision-making authority to appeal, no procedural framework, no concept of appellate review. Appeal is constitutively dependent on law — it IS a legal mechanism, not merely facilitated by it.

An appeal is a formal request for review that must be articulated and communicated. Remove language and appeals cannot be formulated, transmitted, or adjudicated — they cease to function as a construct. This is present-tense constitutive necessity per Laws 8/8a.

Legal dissent is a procedural mechanism within law — removing law stops dissent from operating as a formal mechanism. Like habeas-corpus and arraignment, dissent requires the legal framework to function. Dissent in a legal context is the act of disagreeing with a majority decision within the legal process.

A siglum — a shortened reference form used in scholarly citations of manuscripts — depends on manuscript culture to function. Without the practice of manuscript production and preservation, there are no manuscripts to abbreviate references to. The dependency is constitutive: remove manuscript culture and sigla lose all meaning.

A compact (formal agreement between parties) constitutively depends on language: without language there is no mechanism to articulate terms, express consent, or maintain the compact as a shared understanding. Language is the substrate through which compacts exist.
A shelf as a named organizational concept depends on language: the very idea of a shelf as a categorization tool requires language to label contents, define boundaries, and communicate purpose.

Dissent requires an authority structure to operate against. Remove authority (political, social, institutional structures that constrain or govern) and the concept of dissent loses all meaning — there is nothing to dissent from. The directed nature of dissent (against an authority) makes authority constitutive, not merely incidental.

A checklist is constitutively dependent on language: without symbolic encoding, a checklist cannot exist. The very structure of itemized sequential reference requires language to specify, order, and retrieve entries. Remove language and the checklist ceases to operate.
An injunction requires a court to issue it — without a court, no injunction can exist. Present-tense constitutive dependency, not merely historical association.
A grievance cannot exist without language — it must be articulated, named, and communicated. Without language, there is no mechanism to express a grievance. Present-tense constitutive dependency.

Causation as a concept is constitutively dependent on cognition: the very idea of cause-and-effect is a cognitive construct. Remove cognition and there is no concept of causation — only events happening. The human-made concept of causation requires cognitive processing to exist.

A treatise is inherently a written form — its systematic, comprehensive nature requires the permanence, revisability, and structural clarity that writing provides. Without writing, you have oral teaching or lecture, not a treatise. The written medium is constitutive: the treatise's argumentative structure depends on the ability to review, revise, and reference its own text — capabilities unique to writing.
An archetype is a specific kind of concept: a universal, recurring pattern representing fundamental human experiences (the mother, the hero, the journey). Specific→general, satisfying Law 9.

Persuasion is communication aimed at changing another's beliefs or actions. Remove communication and persuasion cannot operate at all — it is constitutive, not merely facilitative. Persuasion literally IS a subset of communicative acts; without the capacity to communicate, persuasion has no medium.

Habeas corpus is a legal mechanism requiring the existence of law to operate. Remove law and the concept of a writ commanding production of a detained person ceases to function — it is a constitutive dependency on legal framework, not merely historical association.

Arraignment is a judicial procedure that requires a court to exist. Remove the court and arraignment — the formal reading of charges before a judicial body — cannot operate. Present-tense constitutive dependency.

Habeas corpus is a writ requiring judicial review. Remove the court and the writ cannot be executed — it is a mechanism of judicial oversight over executive detention. Constitutive dependency on judicial authority.

A subpoena is a writ ordering a person to appear before a court or judicial body. It requires a court/judicial authority to exist and operate now — you cannot have a subpoena without one. This is a present-tense necessity (Law 8), not a historical claim.

An appeal is a judicial review by a higher court of a lower court's decision. Remove the court system and appeal cannot exist — it is constitutively dependent on judicial institutions, not merely facilitated by them.

Concept-mapping is a formal practice of creating visual representations of concepts and their relationships. Without writing/drawing to persist the map, the practice cannot operate — the visual notation is constitutive to the method, not merely facilitative.

Analogy is a specific form of reasoning — 'analogy is a kind of reasoning' maps to INSTANCE_OF. Chronology test: reasoning (epoch 0.07) predates analogy (epoch 24.01), consistent with reasoning being the general and analogy the specific case.
Canonical is a specific kind of standard — that which is recognized as authoritative and conforming to the accepted norm. specific→general per Law 9.
Grievance is a specific kind of language construct — a formalized expression of complaint that operates through linguistic convention.
Parody is a specific language technique — imitation of a style or work for comic effect or criticism. It is a kind of language act.

A criterion must be stated or statable in language to operate as a decision rule — without linguistic encoding, it collapses into unarticulated preference. The present-tense necessity test: remove language, and criteria cease to function as evaluative standards. This is constitutive, not facilitative, because the very operation of a criterion as a human-made construct requires symbolic expression.

Arbitration requires law to operate — an arbitrator's authority, the enforceability of awards, and the framework that compels participation all derive from legal systems. Remove law and arbitration loses its binding force and becomes mere mediation.
A paradigm is a specific kind of worldview — a particular framework for understanding reality. INSTANCE_OF per Law 9: specific→general.

Falsification needs criteria to test against — remove criterion (standards of evaluation) and falsification cannot operate. This is constitutive, not merely facilitative: without a standard, there is nothing to falsify against.

Pattern recognition requires categorization — recognizing a pattern means identifying what category of things are co-occurring. Remove category (the map of kinds) and pattern recognition ceases to function.

Parody derives from irony: irony (the gap between surface meaning and actual meaning) existed first and fed into the development of parody as a literary/rhetorical form. Parody is historically and conceptually built on the mechanism of ironic distortion.
A verdict requires a court to produce it — remove the court and the verdict ceases to exist. This is constitutive dependency, not mere facilitation. Present-tense necessity.

Formalism requires criteria to operate — it is the application of formal criteria/rules to a domain. Without criteria, formalism has nothing to formalize; the dependency is constitutive, not merely facilitative. A formal system without criteria is just a collection of symbols.

An isomorphism is a specific kind of pattern — namely a structure-preserving mapping between two domains. 'X is a specific kind of Y' maps to INSTANCE_OF per Law 9. Isomorphism inherits all pattern properties (recurring structure) and adds the constraint of preservation.

Cognitive biases are systematic errors that operate through heuristics (mental shortcuts). Remove heuristics — the cognitive mechanism that biases exploit — and cognitive biases cannot function. Heuristics are the operational substrate; biases are distortions of heuristics.

Grievance is a formal complaint mechanism that constitutionally depends on law/legal frameworks. Remove law and grievance as an institution ceases to operate — it needs legal standing, procedures, and institutional backing to function.
Abduction (inference to the best explanation) is a specific type of inferential reasoning. Specific→general: abduction is a kind of inference, alongside deduction and induction.

A ledger is a specific kind of record — a systematic, organized account of transactions or items. Ledger is a specialized form of record-keeping with structured entries, making this a correct INSTANCE_OF direction.
A checklist is a specific kind of framework — a structured list designed to ensure consistency and completeness of tasks. Specific→general direction per Law 9.

Equity is a specific kind of justice — it is justice applied with regard to fairness, impartiality, and consideration of individual circumstances. The direction is correct: specific (equity) → general (justice). This is a genuine INSTANCE_OF relationship.

Sense-making constitutively depends on representation: making sense of anything requires representational constructs (mental models, symbols, maps) to mediate between the world and the agent. Remove representations and sense-making stops — this is a present-tense necessity, not mere association (Law 8).

Canon is the authoritative list — it exists only when a community accords authority to its contents. Remove authority and the practice of canon-formation and canon-maintenance cease; the concept collapses. Constitutive present-tense dependency.

Scaffolding is a specific kind of framework: a provisional structure built to support development or learning, designed to be removed once the target can stand alone. 'Scaffolding is a specific kind of framework' — INSTANCE_OF.

A scaffold is a specific type of tool — a temporary structure used to support workers and materials during construction or maintenance. The direction is correct (specific→general). Tool is a near-universal target per Law 11c.

Formalism as a method of analysis treats cultural artifacts as structured systems of signs and relations. It is constitutively dependent on semiotics because its methodology — reading form as meaning — requires the semiotic framework to distinguish structural features from arbitrary ones.

Iconography is a specific type of semiotic system — the study and interpretation of visual symbols and images. Iconography is a specialized branch of semiotics applied to visual arts, making the INSTANCE_OF direction correct (specific → general).

Burden of proof constitutively depends on evidence — remove evidence as a concept and practice and burden of proof ceases to operate. The whole point of burden of proof is assigning who must produce evidence; without evidence there is nothing to bear the burden against. Present-tense necessity, not mere chronology.
corollary cannot exist without a prior proved theorem — the theorem is the parent from which the corollary is derived. The theorem existed first and fed into the corollary.

Decision-making needs criteria to operate: to choose between options, one must have standards for evaluation. Without criteria, decision-making cannot function — there would be no basis for comparison. This is constitutive, not merely facilitative, just as criterion→DEPENDS_ON→language was accepted: criteria are the constitutive apparatus of decision-making.

Modeling requires representation to operate: a model IS a representation of something else. Without the capacity to represent, modeling cannot exist. The dependency is constitutive — remove representation from the conceptual landscape and modeling ceases to be possible.

A catalog is a specific kind of inventory — specifically, an organized inventory with descriptions, often systematic. The relationship is specific→general: catalog INSTANCE_OF inventory. This follows Law 9 — 'catalog is a specific kind of inventory' is always INSTANCE_OF.
A scheme depends on modeling: without the capacity to create and manipulate models, no scheme can exist. The structured arrangement of elements in a scheme is a form of model.

Canon (the authoritative body of texts, works, or doctrines in a tradition) derives historically from law. The concept of a 'canon' as a settled, authoritative collection originated in legal contexts where canonical texts and precedents were established. Law (epoch 0.79) predates canon (epoch 0.99), and the idea of canonical authority flows from the legal authority of established rules and texts.

A bias requires memory to operate: the systematic tendency persists only because patterns are stored, recalled, and rehearsed. Remove memory and the recurring tilt that defines bias collapses — there is no shortcut without storage and retrieval.

A scheme is a structured symbolic framework. Without language (the symbol system that encodes and transmits patterns), a scheme collapses into mere habit — not a catalogued construct. Language is constitutive of scheme as a corporatum.

Conceptual blending operates by mapping elements across mental spaces. Without representation (the cognitive infrastructure of mental spaces), there is nothing to blend. Representations are the substrate on which blending acts — constitutive, not merely facilitative.
cognitive-bias is a specific kind of bias — it applies the general bias construct to cognitive/judgment domains. Law 9: specific→general is INSTANCE_OF.

Presumption is an epistemic rule about how to treat evidence when it is insufficient — without evidence as the substrate it operates on, presumption has nothing to govern; the dependency is constitutive (Law 8)

A benchmark is a reference standard that only functions through measurement. Remove measurement right now and a benchmark cannot serve as a standard — it has no way to quantify or compare. The dependency is constitutive, not merely historical.

Codices are bound manuscript volumes that historically derive from writing practice. Writing existed first and fed into the codex form — the codex is a material technology built upon the earlier practice of writing.

Fallacy is a reasoning error — a defect in the process of drawing conclusions. The concept of fallacy has no referent without the concept of reasoning: a fallacy IS a failure of reasoning. Remove reasoning and the notion of fallacy cannot operate at all. Present-tense constitutive necessity.
Analogical reasoning is a specific kind of reasoning — it maps structure from one domain to another following reasoning's rules. 'X is a specific kind of Y' is the pattern for INSTANCE_OF.
Cognitive biases require memory systems to operate — they are systematic patterns that emerge from how memories are encoded, stored, and retrieved. Remove memory and cognitive biases cease to exist.

reversed — cognitive-bias is a specific kind of bias, so bias CONTAINS cognitive-bias or cognitive-bias INSTANCE_OF bias. But the entry 'bias' is broader than 'cognitive-bias' — cognitive-bias is a specific type of bias, so cognitive-bias INSTANCE_OF bias is correct direction
warranty is a specific kind of contract — a specific commitment to guarantee quality, title, or performance. warranty is a kind of contract passes the specific→general test for INSTANCE_OF.

Burden-of-proof is an operational mechanism that assigns who must justify a claim — and this only works because the system presupposes that some claims need justification while others don't. Remove presupposition (the practice of taking-for-granted certain defaults) and the burden of proof has no mechanism to assign burdens: there would be no default position against which to measure the required proof. This is a present-tense constitutive dependency, not mere chronology.

Standard-of-proof sets the evidentiary threshold for what counts as sufficient — it operates directly on evidence as its substrate. Remove evidence and the standard has nothing to measure against, no threshold to apply. This is the same constitutive relationship as burden-of-proof→evidence: evidence is the raw material that the standard-of-proof processes.
Retroduction IS a specific form of abduction (inference to the best explanation). Direction: specific→general per Law 9.

Semiosis IS the process of meaning through representation — a sign must represent something to an interpreter for semiosis to operate. Remove representation and semiosis collapses. Constitutive per Laws 8/8a.
proxy is a specific kind of representation — it stands in for something else, which is the defining feature of representation. 'X is a specific kind of Y' → INSTANCE_OF.

Discourse needs language operating right now to function — remove language and discourse stops immediately. This is present-tense constitutive necessity, not mere chronology. Language is the substrate without which discourse cannot exist.

Pragmatics (the study of meaning beyond the literal) constitutively depends on presupposition: every pragmatic inference — implicature, deixis, speaker meaning — requires background assumptions (presuppositions) to bridge the gap between encoded content and intended meaning. Remove presupposition and pragmatics stops working entirely.
Induction is a specific form of inference — reasoning from specific observations to general conclusions. Law 9: specific→general. Induction IS-A kind of inference.

Analogy needs representation to operate now — you cannot map between domains without representational structures. The mapping relation itself IS a representational act. Constitutive: remove representation and analogical reasoning ceases.

A signifier is a specific kind of representation — something that stands for or denotes something else. 'X is a kind of Y' test: a signifier IS a representation (of its referent). Direction: specific→general holds.

A stipulation is a specific kind of convention — a normative rule established by formal declaration or agreement. 'X is a kind of Y': a stipulation IS a type of convention (one set by explicit decree rather than emergent practice). Direction: specific→general.

Fallibilism IS the doctrine that knowledge can never achieve certainty. It requires the concept of knowledge to operate now — remove knowledge from the conceptual vocabulary and fallibilism has no substrate to attach to. This is constitutive, not merely facilitative.

Fallibilism is the epistemic principle that certainty is unattainable. Its entire content requires uncertainty as a concept — if uncertainty were removed, fallibilism would have nothing to be about. This is constitutive: fallibilism needs uncertainty to operate now, not just historically.

Conjecture is a specific kind of hypothesis — a tentative explanatory proposition formed without sufficient evidence for confirmation. The note states: conjecture IS a type of hypothesis, distinguished by its evidential status.
Analogy is a specific kind of representation: it represents one domain in terms of another, mapping structure from a source onto a target. The direction is correct — specific→general.

A checklist is a specific kind of tool — a cognitive aid that standardizes and sequences tasks to reduce error. The direction is correct: specific→general. This is true even though 'tool' is a universal target (Law 11c).

A compilation gathers existing information into a structured, persistent record. INSTANCE_OF is correct: compilation is a specific kind of record (the general category 'record' is accepted). A compilation IS a record, not merely USES one.

A shelf is a physical structure designed to hold, organize, and enable retrieval of stored items. INSTANCE_OF→tool: a shelf IS a kind of tool — it extends human capacity for spatial organization and material handling. Law 11c confirms tool-instance edges are valid; tool-ness is what being made IS.
A scheme is a specific kind of framework — a structured pattern or systematic arrangement used to organize thought or action. 'X is a specific kind of Y': scheme IS a framework variant.

Synthesis requires representation to operate now — you cannot recombine elements into a new whole without first representing those elements. This is constitutive: without representational capacity, synthesis ceases to function.
notion is a specific type of concept — a preliminary idea or mental construct. Specific→general INSTANCE_OF is correct.
falsifiability is a specific type of criterion — a standard by which something can be proven wrong. However, 'criterion' doesn't exist as an entry. Need to find target.

concept mapping as a technique requires language as its constitutive medium — concept maps are visual representations of relationships between ideas, and the nodes and links are labelled in language. Without language, concept mapping cannot operate.

praxis is a specific kind of practice — one that is reflective, value-laden, and aimed at transformation. Specific→general per Law 9. 'Praxis is a kind of practice' is unambiguously INSTANCE_OF, never CONTAINS or DEPENDS_ON.

Rhetoric as a practice constitutionally requires persuasion — its entire function is to produce persuasion through discourse. Remove persuasion as the aim and rhetoric ceases to be rhetoric. Present-tense necessity per Law 8/8a, not mere historical association.
rationalization IS a specific kind of cognitive-bias (specific→general, per Law 9). A pattern of reasoning that constructs plausible but false justifications for beliefs or actions.
anchoring IS a specific kind of cognitive-bias (specific→general). A bias where initial exposure to a value disproportionately influences subsequent judgments.
stereotype IS a specific kind of cognitive-bias (specific→general). A fixed, oversimplified image or idea about a particular type of person or thing.

Orthodoxy IS a kind of convention — specifically, a convention that establishes accepted belief as normative within a domain. 'X is a specific kind of Y' pattern: orthodoxy is a type of convention governing what counts as correct belief.

Humor operates by incongruity — violating expectations built from stored knowledge. Remove knowledge-representation (the capacity to encode, organize, and retrieve conceptual frameworks) and humor has no substrate to distort; it cannot function.

Causation is the conceptual framework for linking events through cause-effect relationships. Encoding, storing, and reasoning about causal chains requires knowledge-representation as the underlying mechanism. Remove KR and causal reasoning has no representational substrate.

Confirmation-bias is a specific cognitive bias — the tendency to search for, interpret, and recall information that confirms one's preexisting beliefs. It is a subtype of the general cognitive-bias category.

A screwdriver is a specific kind of hand tool used for driving screws. INSTANCE_OF direction is correct: specific (screwdriver) → general (tool). The screwdriver extends the human hand into a rotational force-applying instrument, making it a clear instance of the tool category.

Knowledge-representation cannot operate without reasoning: structuring, validating, and organizing representations all require reasoning as a constitutive capacity. Remove reasoning and knowledge-representation collapses.
fallibilism is a specific philosophical concept (the principle that certainty is unattainable). Direction: specific→general, satisfying Law 9.
causation is a specific conceptual framework humans use to explain why events occur. Direction: specific→general, satisfying Law 9. It is a map/concept about the world, not the world itself (Law 2a).
category is a specific kind of concept. Direction: specific→general = INSTANCE_OF.

Availability bias is a specific cognitive bias where people judge frequency or probability by ease of recall. Availability bias is a kind of cognitive bias — the specific-to-general direction is correct.

An anthology is a specific kind of compilation — a curated collection of creative works gathered from various sources. The direction anthology→compilation maps specific to general: anthology IS a type of compilation, distinguished by curatorial intent and publication as a unified volume.

Pattern-recognition is a specific type of cognitive process — the mind's ability to identify regularities, structures, and meaningful configurations in data. Direction: specific (pattern-recognition) to general (cognition). Law 9.
A lens is a specific kind of tool — an optical instrument that refracts light. Tool-ness is near-universal (Law 11c); lens IS a tool. Direction: specific to general. Law 9.

Storytelling requires synthesis as a constitutive mechanism — a storyteller must synthesize events, characters, themes, and perspectives into a coherent narrative whole. Remove synthesis and storytelling stops working; there is no storytelling without the synthesis of disparate elements into narrative unity.
cognitive-dissonance is a specific type of cognitive bias: the mental discomfort from holding contradictory beliefs, as theorized by Festinger.

A nudge operates by exploiting existing cognitive shortcuts — without heuristics, nudges cease to function as the mechanism that defines them. Remove heuristics (make people perfectly rational) and a nudge is no longer a nudge but either information or a prohibition. This is constitutive, not merely facilitative.

Knowledge representation formalizes knowledge using logical structures (ontologies, frames, semantic networks). Remove logical formalism and knowledge representation as a discipline ceases to operate.
iconography requires semiotic literacy to function; remove semiotics and iconography loses its capacity to convey meaning
A frame is a specific kind of cognitive structure — it is a category of concept that organizes interpretation. The direction runs from specific (frame) to general (concept).

A thesaurus is constitutively dependent on language — it organizes words, meanings, and semantic relationships. Remove language and the thesaurus cannot exist or function at all. This is a constitutive dependency (Law 8a), not merely facilitative.

An availability heuristic is a specific kind of heuristic — it is the heuristic that judges frequency/probability by ease of recall. 'X is a specific kind of Y' maps to INSTANCE_OF. The specific (availability-heuristic) points at the general (heuristic).

An availability heuristic is a specific kind of cognitive bias — a systematic deviation from rational judgment that falls under the broader taxonomy of cognitive biases. The specific (availability-heuristic) points at the general (cognitive-bias). INSTANCE_OF direction.

synthesis needs storytelling to operate: the act of weaving disparate materials into coherent meaning requires narrative structure as its organizing substrate. Remove storytelling and synthesis loses its primary mechanism for binding meaning.

Semiotics studies signs and meaning; language is the primary system of signs. Remove language and semiotics as a discipline stops operating — semiotic analysis of signs requires linguistic signs as its constitutive substrate. Present-tense necessity, not chronology.
working-memory is a specific kind of memory system — a bounded model for temporary storage and manipulation. Memory is the general concept of information retention. Specific→general mapping.
Fallibilism is a specific epistemological position — the theory that no knowledge claim is beyond revision. Specific case of the general field of epistemology (study of knowledge).

Belief bias is a specific type of cognitive bias: the tendency to judge an argument's validity based on the plausibility of its conclusion rather than its logical form. Direction tested: specific (belief-bias) → general (cognitive-bias). This is the correct INSTANCE_OF direction per Law 9.

icon is a specific kind of representation. Representation is anything that stands in for something else. An icon is a specific form of representation that operates through resemblance or conventional symbol. Specific→general = INSTANCE_OF.

Causation needs inference to operate now — we cannot identify, express, or use causal relationships without making inferences from evidence. Remove inference and causal reasoning ceases. This is constitutive, not merely facilitative.
A corpus — a collection of texts used for analysis — requires language to exist. Without language, the concept and the practice collapse entirely. Constitutive dependency.

An icon is a specific type of iconographic artifact/creation. Iconography is the broader category encompassing all symbolic visual representations and the art of creating them. Specific→general mapping per Law 9.
stipulation as a formal constraint in law/contracts requires language to express and enforce it; removing language makes stipulation impossible
Iconography is a specific kind of representation system — a structured set of visual symbols and their meanings. The specific (iconography) points at the general (representation). Law 9.

Test: categorization IS a specific kind of classification (Law 9). Categorization is the practice of grouping items by shared features; classification is the broader system of organizing by criteria. Direction: specific → general. INSTANCE_OF is correct.

Test: remove attention (the cognitive resource that allocates processing capacity) — cognitive-load as a concept becomes meaningless without it. Per Law 8, present-tense necessity: cognitive load cannot operate without the limited attention it describes. DEPENDS_ON.
Test: schema IS a specific kind of mental model (Law 9). Schemas are structured knowledge frameworks; mental models is the broader category. Direction: specific → general. INSTANCE_OF.

Conceptual metaphor (understanding one concept in terms of another via cross-domain mapping) depends on synthesis: you cannot construct a metaphor without synthesizing two distinct domains into a coherent cross-wire. Remove synthesis and conceptual-metaphor's core mechanism ceases to function. Present-tense necessity holds.

Epistemic rationality (forming beliefs that accurately track the world) depends on synthesis: updating beliefs in light of evidence, integrating information across sources, and reconciling contradictory data all require synthesizing disparate inputs into coherent updated models. Remove synthesis and epistemic-rationality's core mechanism — belief updating — stops working.

An inventory is a specific kind of catalog — it systematically lists items within a defined scope (possessions, stock, resources). Catalog is the general concept; inventory narrows it to enumerated holdings.
A catalog is a specific kind of record — an organized, systematic listing of items or information. Record is the general category; catalog specifies the systematic/organized variant.

A formal grievance is a legal construct that requires the law as its substrate. Without the legal framework — the right to complain, the procedure, the remedy — a grievance cannot function as a grievance. Constitutive dependency.
lexicon IS a specific kind of catalog — both are organized lists, but lexicon is domain-specific to words and their meanings. Direction specific to general per Law 9.
register IS a specific kind of catalog — a formal list of items or transactions. Direction specific to general per Law 9.

Humor is a specific mode of communication that uses incongruity, surprise, or play to elicit amusement and signal social bonds. Removing communication removes humor entirely — humor cannot function without a communicative channel.
taxonomy is a specific kind of classification system — it organizes entities into hierarchical categories based on shared properties. Specific→general.
A footnote requires writing to function — it cannot exist without a written medium to anchor its reference. This is present-tense constitutive necessity, not chronology.

A provision (formal clause or stipulation) cannot exist or operate without language — it IS a linguistic construct that defines rights, conditions, or arrangements. Remove language and the provision vanishes.
A compendium is a collection of knowledge compiled in written or spoken form. It requires language as its substrate — without language there is no compilation, no collection, no compendium.
A laptop is a specific kind of portable computer. Specific→general INSTANCE_OF direction tested and confirmed.
Abductive reasoning is a specific form of reasoning that infers the best explanation. Specific→general, INSTANCE_OF confirmed.
socks is a specific kind of clothing — a garment covering the foot. Clear specific→general INSTANCE_OF per Law 9. Not a part-of (CONTAINS) or use (DEPENDS_ON).

Concepts require knowledge-representation to be structured, shared, and persisted. Remove KR (notation, formal encoding, symbolic systems) and concepts lose their ability to function as communicable constructs. Constitutive present-tense dependency per Law 8.
shelf is a specific kind of tool (a storage device extending the capacity to hold objects). Law 11c: near-universal target 'tool' may be edged freely.
A garden hoe is a specific kind of tool that extends the human hand for cultivation. Per Law 9, INSTANCE_OF = specific→general. 'A garden hoe is a kind of tool' is unambiguously true.
Liturgy IS a kind of ritual — specifically a formal, standardized religious/ceremonial practice. The specific→general direction: liturgy is a subtype of the broader ritual category.

Marginalia are notes written in the margins of documents. They depend on writing as their substrate — remove writing and marginalia cannot exist or function. This is constitutive, not merely facilitative.
jargon is a specific type of specialized vocabulary within a lexicon. Direction tested: lexicon (epoch 0.1) predates jargon (epoch 0.99). INSTANCE_OF per Law 9: jargon is a specific kind of lexicon.
Heraldic practice requires blazon — a formal descriptive language with its own grammar and syntax. Remove heraldic language and the herald loses their operational medium entirely.

A grievance as a formal claim requires the legal/institutional framework to operate — without law and grievance procedures, a formal grievance ceases to function. Constitutive, not merely facilitative.
A palimpsest — a manuscript scraped clean and reused — fundamentally requires writing to exist. Without writing there can be no palimpsest. Constitutive dependency.

A proviso is a conditional clause that operates through language — its function of suspending or conditioning a statement requires linguistic structure to express the condition. Remove language and a proviso ceases to exist as a meaningful construct.

A proviso is a specific type of provision — it is a conditional clause attached to a broader provision. Per Law 9, X is a specific kind of Y → INSTANCE_OF. A proviso is a particular form of provision, constrained by conditions.

A colophon is a brief statement at the end of a printed book, typically about its production. It is a physical marker embedded in writing/print. Without writing, a colophon cannot exist — the relationship is constitutive.
An epigraph is a phrase, quotation, or poem placed at the beginning of a text. The concept requires language — without language, there can be no epigraph. This is constitutive dependency.
Epigraphs are inscribed words — they need writing to exist. Remove writing and epigraphs cease to function. This is constitutive, not merely facilitative.
Marginalia are written words in margins — they need language to exist. Remove language and marginalia (as meaningful text) stops functioning. Constitutive dependency.

A ledger cannot operate without a symbolic system to encode entries — language in the broad sense of structured symbolic representation. Remove language and the ledger becomes unintelligible noise. This is constitutive, not merely facilitative.
A steward as an institutional role constitutionally depends on law — remove legal authority/framework and the steward role ceases to function. This is present-tense necessity, not chronology.

A labyrinth as a designed structure constitutionally depends on architecture — remove architectural knowledge (spatial planning, enclosure, passage design) and a labyrinth cannot exist. Present-tense constitutive dependency on a substrate.
A gloss is a brief explanation or annotation attached to text. It requires language to operate: remove language and you cannot have a gloss. This is present-tense constitutive, not historical.

Test: which-came-first → writing predates catchwords by millennia. Test: remove-writing → catchwords cease to exist, as they are scribe annotations on written pages requiring writing to function. Constitutive dependency: a catchword is by definition a word on a written page.

Test: which-came-first → writing predates incipits. Test: remove-writing → incipits cease to exist, as they are decorative opening marks on written works. Constitutive: an incipit is by definition a visual marker on a written text's opening — without writing there is no incipit.
A catchword is a typographic convention where a word appears at page breaks for navigation; it needs language to function — without language the practice collapses.

A grievance requires law (broadly: rules, procedures, recognized rights) to exist as a construct. Without a framework that defines what can be complained about and how, grievance cannot operate. Remove law and grievance ceases to function — constitutive dependency.

Epistemic violence operates through language and knowledge systems — the marginalization, silencing, or distortion of groups via discourse. Remove language and epistemic violence has no medium. This is constitutive, not merely facilitative.

Errata are corrections appended to a printed/written text. Remove writing and there is no written text to correct — errata have no mechanism to exist without the written medium. This is present-tense constitutive necessity.

A recension is the critical comparison of different manuscript versions to establish a text. Without writing there are no manuscripts to compare — the entire practice collapses. Remove writing and recension ceases to operate.

Remove writing now and scholia cease to operate — they are written annotations on texts, persisted across copies. The dependency is constitutive: scholia exist only as written marginal/interlinear commentary.

The internet constitutionally requires networks to operate: without networks, the internet literally cannot function. This is present-tense necessity per Law 8 — remove networks and the internet stops working. Not merely historical association.
A codex exists to carry written content. Remove writing as a practice and a codex becomes blank bound paper — it loses its purpose and identity. Writing is constitutive, not merely facilitative.
shibboleth needs language operating now — without a shared language the concept of a membership-testing word cannot function
onomatopoeia — words that imitate sounds — requires language to operate. Without language, sound-imitating words cannot function.
