A codicil is a supplementary or amending clause added to a written document (will, treaty, statute). Remove writing and the codicil cannot exist — it is a textual construct that requires the medium of writing to operate. Present-tense constitutive dependency.

Commentary is a written explanation or annotation of a text. It is a genre of written discourse that requires writing to exist — you cannot have written commentary without the medium of writing. Constitutive present-tense dependency.

A notary's function is to authenticate and certify written documents. Remove writing and the notary has nothing to notarize — the role collapses. This is present-tense necessity, not historical association.
A lemma (in linguistics) depends on language to exist — without a language there can be no lemma. The concept of a lemma is constitutively linguistic.
A caveat is a warning or proviso expressed through language. The concept only exists as a linguistic act — it is constitutively dependent on language for its existence.
macbook-air is a specific model/brand of laptop. 'A MacBook Air is a kind of laptop' — specific→general INSTANCE_OF relationship.
Myth existed first and fed into the labyrinth concept (Minotaur's maze). Which-came-first test: myth predates labyrinth as a structured concept.
A civic engagement platform is a technological construct that needs technology to function — without digital infrastructure the platform cannot operate. Present-tense necessity, constitutive.
A steward operates through trust — without trust the steward relationship collapses. Present-tense necessity: remove trust and stewardship ceases to function.
A bailiff as a court officer role constitutionally requires law to function — remove law and the bailiff role ceases to exist. This is present-tense necessity, not chronology.

Collation — the process of comparing and assembling written texts — constitutionally requires writing. Remove writing and collation as a practice ceases to operate. This is a textual concept depending on its substrate.

commentary is a specific kind of hermeneutic activity — interpreting and annotating texts. The specific (commentary) points at the general (hermeneutics). Commentary operates as a practiced form of hermeneutic interpretation.
exemplar is a specific kind of model — a representative example set up for imitation or guidance. The specific (exemplar) points at the general (model).

A grievance is a structured complaint that requires language to exist as a concept and to be articulated. Without language, no grievance can be formed or expressed — the dependency is constitutive, not merely facilitative.

The french horn as a musical instrument derives its purpose and meaning from the practice of music. Without music, the french horn is just metal tubing — it depends on music constitutively to function as what it is.
The MacBook Air is a specific brand/model of laptop. Specific→general per Law 9.
tmesis as a linguistic phenomenon requires language to operate — you cannot split a word that does not exist. Language is constitutive of tmesis, not merely facilitative.
commentary is a specific form of writing — it is writing that provides explanation or interpretation. commentary IS-A kind of writing. Which-came-first: writing predates commentary by millennia.

Legends derive from myth as a narrative tradition. Myths are the older, more general category of sacred/primordial stories; legends developed as a distinct but related form focusing on historical figures/events. which-came-first: myth predates legend.
explicit content depends on language to be communicated — removing language, explicit meaning cannot exist
Crossing the Rubicon is a specific kind of metaphor — a historical event that became a metaphor for irreversible commitment. INSTANCE_OF: specific→general.
Adjudication is a specific form of law — the process of making a judicial decision. It IS a kind of legal procedure. INSTANCE_OF: specific→general.
due-process is a legal construct that cannot exist without law — remove law and the concept of due-process ceases to operate. Constitutive necessity per Law 8, not mere chronology.

axiom cannot function without logic — an axiom is a foundational proposition whose role is to serve as a starting point within a logical system. Remove logic and axioms lose their purpose and meaning. Constitutive necessity per Law 8.
Lululemon is an athletic apparel brand; remove clothing and the brand cannot exist. Present-tense constitutive dependency, not mere chronology.
A value proposition must be communicated to serve its function; remove communication and the value proposition cannot be conveyed. Constitutive present-tense dependency.
The concept of anomaly depends on language to name and categorize deviations from the norm — without language there is no concept of anomaly.
An apparatus is a complex arrangement of tools — it needs tools to function. Present-tense dependency holds.
An acquittal is a legal verdict — remove law and there is no acquittal. The concept needs the legal framework to operate right now.

A recension (revised text based on manuscript comparison) needs apographs — copies of manuscripts — to operate. The textual critic compares apographic variants to establish the text. Remove apographs and recension has nothing to work on.
apparatus is a specific kind of tool or piece of equipment used for a particular purpose
the concept of a 'rubicon' as a point of no return originated as a linguistic metaphor from the historical river; the entry denotes the idiom/concept, not the river

tagging operates only through language — labels, tags, and categories are linguistic symbols applied to things. Remove language and tagging ceases to function (Law 8 test). Direction: tagging (newer, epoch 0.99) DEPENDS_ON language (older, epoch 0.07).
An apograph is a handwritten copy of a text not from the original author — the concept is constitutively about written texts. Without writing, there are no apographs.
An indictment is a formal legal charge — it needs law to exist as a concept and practice. Remove law and indictment ceases to operate. Constitutive, not merely facilitative.

Framing-effect (epoch 0.99) is a newer, more specialized construct that emerged from the study of heuristic-based decision-making. Heuristic (epoch 0.31) is the older, more foundational concept. Framing effects describe how the presentation of options influences choices through heuristic processing — the concept of heuristics preceded and enabled the concept of framing effects.

Argumentation needs logic to operate now — without logical principles (validity, inference rules, fallacy detection), argumentation cannot function as a construct. This is present-tense necessity, not chronology.

Skepticism as a construct requires the concept of knowledge — it is doubt directed at knowledge claims. Remove knowledge as a concept and skepticism has no object. This is constitutive, not merely facilitative.

A synopsis is a condensed communicative presentation — it needs communication to operate as a synopsis. Without the construct of communication, a synopsis cannot function as a reduced transmission of content. This is a constitutive present-tense dependency.

An anomaly is a deviation from what is expected — it requires the construct of expectation to function. Remove expectation and anomaly loses its meaning entirely. Constitutive present-tense dependency, not mere chronology.

Discovery requires sustained commitment to a line of inquiry — resources, time, and persistence all require precommitment. Without the capacity to commit forward, discovery collapses into mere curiosity that never invests.
Meta-cognition is cognition about cognition — it needs cognition to operate on. Remove cognition and meta-cognition has nothing to reflect upon. This is a present-tense constitutive dependency.

Credibility is the quality of being believed — it needs evidence to ground that belief. Without evidence, credibility collapses to mere assertion or popularity. Evidence is the present-tense substrate that credibility operates on.
Credibility cannot operate without reputation — credibility IS the quality of being trusted based on one's reputation. Remove reputation and credibility ceases to have meaning.

Simplification needs abstraction to operate now — it cannot function without abstracting away details to produce a reduced representation. The act of simplification is constitutively an act of abstraction.

Calibration needs measurement to operate now — it cannot calibrate instruments without measuring them against a standard. The dependency is constitutive: remove measurement and calibration ceases to exist.

enumeration uses number as its substrate — you cannot enumerate (count items sequentially) without numbers. Per Law 11, this is use-not-kind: enumeration depends on number the way measurement does, it is not a species of number itself.
testimony derives its force from credibility — without credibility the claim is dismissed. Present-tense necessity: remove credibility and testimony ceases to persuade.
Presumption is a specific kind of inference — an inference made without full evidence. Specific→general per Law 9. A presumption IS an inference, just of a particular kind (premature, warrantless).

Discovery depends on knowledge now — one cannot discover something without pre-existing knowledge to provide the framework for recognizing novelty. Knowledge is the substrate without which the concept of discovery cannot operate.

Encoding transforms information into a representational form — it needs symbols to operate now. Remove symbols and encoding cannot function: there is nothing to encode into. This is a constitutive, present-tense dependency, not historical association.
framing-effect is a specific cognitive bias wherein how an option is framed alters choices — it is a kind of cognitive-bias.
apophasis is a specific rhetorical device — the specific instance of the general practice of rhetoric. Law 9: specific→general direction, stated in the note.

The availability bias operates by using ease of recall as a proxy for frequency or probability. Remove memory (the retrieval mechanism) right now and the bias cannot operate — there is no availability heuristic without a memory system that retrieves some examples more readily than others. This is present-tense constitutive dependency.

The framing effect requires language to create different descriptions of equivalent information. Remove language right now and there is no way to present one thing as a gain versus a loss — frames are linguistic constructions. The effect exists only because language provides multiple valid descriptions of the same situation.
simplification is a communicative act — reducing complexity for transmission. It requires language as the medium; without language there is no simplification to perform.

A double-bind is a specific kind of paradox — a communicative paradox where conflicting messages at different logical levels make coherent response impossible. The specific (double-bind) points at the general (paradox). Law 9.

Credibility requires memory to operate now. Without the capacity to store and retrieve information about past behavior, reputation, or claims, credibility as a social construct stops working entirely. The remove-memory test: no memory → no credibility → constitutive dependency.

Sunk-cost fallacy requires memory constitutionally. The bias only operates when one remembers past investments (time, money, effort) and lets them influence present decisions. Remove memory → past investments become inaccessible → sunk-cost fallacy cannot exist. This passes the remove-it-now test.
A sunk-cost fallacy IS a specific type of cognitive bias — the pattern of continuing behavior based on past investment rather than future value. Specific to general mapping.
Simplification as a cognitive/communicative operation requires language to operate — you cannot simplify a concept without a symbolic medium to express it in. Present-tense constitutive dependency.

The abstraction ladder is a linguistic-cognitive tool from general semantics. It operates entirely through language levels — concrete to abstract categories — and cannot exist without a symbolic hierarchy to climb.

trust existed first and fed into credibility. Trust is the basic expectation that others will act reliably; credibility extends this to the assessed quality of a source's reliability. Credibility builds on the prior concept of trust.

Anchoring-bias is a specific cognitive bias where initial values (anchors) disproportionately influence decisions. This is a specific case of the general category 'cognitive-bias'. INSTANCE_OF direction is correct: specific → general.

A garden-hoe is a specific kind of tool (a hand implement for weeding and cultivating soil). Law 9: 'X is a specific kind of Y' is always INSTANCE_OF. The arrow direction is correct: specific (garden-hoe) → general (tool).

Metonymy is a specific figure of speech within rhetoric — substituting the name of one thing for another closely associated thing (e.g. 'the White House' for 'the presidential administration'). Law 9: specific→general is INSTANCE_OF. Correct direction.

Hegemony is rule by consent rather than force — the dominated accept the dominant's authority because ideology shapes what counts as normal, natural, and legitimate. Remove ideology: the mechanism of consent disappears, leaving only raw coercion. Hegemony cannot function without ideology operating as its substrate.

Cognitive load theory is constitutively about working-memory capacity. The concept of cognitive load is defined as the total mental effort imposed on working memory. Remove working memory from the framework and cognitive load has no referent — it is literally the load ON working memory, present-tense necessity.
negativity-bias is a specific kind of cognitive-bias: the tendency for negative information or events to exert greater psychological influence than equally intense positive ones. Specific→general.
optimism-bias is a specific kind of cognitive-bias: the tendency to believe one is less at risk of negative outcomes than others. Specific→general.
hegemony is a specific form of power — the dominance of one group over others achieved through consent and ideological control (Gramsci), not mere coercion. Specific→general.

precommitment binds future actions by recording intentions in advance; it requires memory to retrieve those intentions when the future moment arrives. Remove memory and precommitment cannot operate — constitutive present-tense dependency.
Abjuration requires language as its constitutive substrate — without language, the formal renunciation cannot be enacted. The performative speech act of abjuration IS a linguistic act.
The concept of complementarity persists through language and scientific terminology. The word and the conceptual framework are the only way complementarity exists in human culture.
The concept of complementarity emerged from scientific practice — specifically Bohr's physics work on wave-particle duality in the 1920s. Science existed first and fed complementarity into existence.

Complementarity is a mode of reasoning — a way of thinking about mutually exclusive but jointly necessary descriptions. It depends on reasoning as its operational substrate; without the capacity for conceptual reasoning, complementarity cannot function.

Abjuration typically occurs within ritual frameworks — religious, legal, or diplomatic. The formal structure and ceremonial context are constitutive of abjuration as practiced. Remove ritual structure and abjuration becomes mere speech.
Simplification needs language to operate now — you cannot simplify a concept without linguistic representation to carry the reduced form. Language is the vehicle for the simplified form.
hindsight-bias is a specific kind of cognitive bias (the tendency to see past events as having been predictable). 'Hindsight bias is a specific case of bias' — clear INSTANCE_OF.

Cognitive mapping — the mental construction of spatial-like representations of knowledge relationships — requires memory as its constitutive substrate. Without memory structures (encoding, storage, retrieval), no cognitive map can form or function. Remove memory and cognitive mapping has no mechanism to operate.

Hindsight bias — the tendency to retroactively see past outcomes as having been predictable — requires memory as its constitutive substrate. Without memory of the original prediction, the bias has no mechanism to operate. Remove memory and the cognitive distortion cannot function.

Elaborative interrogation — the pedagogical technique of prompting learners to ask explanatory 'why' and 'how' questions to deepen understanding — requires education as its constitutive context. Without educational frameworks (teaching methods, learning objectives, instructional design), elaborative interrogation is just random questioning. It only operates as a defined construct within education.

The worked-example-effect operates through learning processes — novices study solved exemplars to build schemas. Remove learning and the technique has nothing to act upon; it ceases to function. The dependency is present-tense and constitutive.

The worked-example-effect functions by managing cognitive load in novices during skill acquisition. The entire technique is designed to prevent cognitive overload. Remove cognitive load and the effect has no mechanism to operate upon. Present-tense constitutive dependency.

Cognitive mapping requires simplifying complex information into representable structures. The mapper must distill and abstract — a form of simplification — to produce a map that is usable. Remove simplification (the capacity to reduce complexity) and cognitive mapping cannot produce a tractable representation. Present-tense constitutive dependency.

Chunking is a memory organization strategy — it works by grouping information into meaningful units within memory. Remove memory and chunking has nothing to operate on; it is constitutive, not merely facilitative.

belief-persistence is a specific kind of cognitive bias: the tendency to maintain a belief even after receiving disconfirming evidence. 'belief-persistence is a specific case of cognitive-bias' → Law 9 INSTANCE_OF.
perspective-taking is a specific cognitive practice — a kind of cognition that adopts another's viewpoint. Specific→general direction.

Remove memory — the capacity to encode, store, and retrieve information — and the generation effect ceases to operate: there is no recall advantage without memory. The production→retention link is a present-tense necessity, not chronology.

Cognitive-offloading is the practice of using external tools to reduce cognitive load — it fundamentally depends on the existence of memory systems (internal and external) to offload to. Without memory as a capacity, offloading has nothing to offload onto. This is a present-tense dependency: remove memory and cognitive-offloading ceases to function.

Priming is a specific kind of cognitive bias: prior exposure to stimuli systematically influences subsequent responses without conscious awareness, creating a predictable deviation from unbiased judgment. This is the classic definition of a cognitive bias (Law 9: specific→general).
meta-category is a specific kind of category — namely, a category that classifies other categories. Specific→general INSTANCE_OF.
reasoning-bias is a specific kind of cognitive bias that systematically distorts reasoning processes. Specific→general INSTANCE_OF.

framing is a specific cognitive bias: the framing effect where people decide between options differently depending on how options are presented (positive vs negative framing). The framing effect is a documented instance of systematic cognitive bias in decision-making.

Pattern recognition needs memory to operate: without stored patterns in memory, there is no basis for comparison or recognition. Remove memory and pattern recognition stops — it requires the retention and retrieval of previously encountered regularities.

elaborative-interrogation works by prompting learners to generate explanations that connect new information to prior knowledge stored in memory. Without memory, there is no prior knowledge to connect to, and the mechanism stops functioning.

Priming effects operate through activated memory traces — remove memory and priming stops working entirely. This is a present-tense dependency: the subconscious activation of stored associations requires memory to function.
Anchoring bias is a specific cognitive bias where initial information disproportionately influences subsequent judgments. This is a specific case of the general category bias.
Epistemic-loops require tracking beliefs, evidence, and revisions over time. Without memory, one cannot check or revise knowledge — the loop cannot close.
Reinforcement requires associating actions with consequences across time. Without memory of the outcome, reinforcement cannot operate.
counting is a specific method of enumeration: enumeration is the general practice of counting items one by one, and counting is the systematic method of doing so. Specific→general.

Spacing-effect (retention benefit of distributed over massed practice) depends on memory — the effect only operates because spaced repetitions allow memory traces to partially decay and rebuild. Without memory, there is no spacing effect.

Connotation is the property of linguistic signs carrying associative meanings beyond their literal denotation. It only exists within language and cultural meaning-making systems. Remove language and connotation cannot operate — it is constitutively dependent on language as its substrate.

denotation is the layer of literal, dictionary meaning a word carries within a language system. Remove language and denotation ceases to exist — this is a present-tense dependency, not merely historical.
spaced-repetition is a learning technique whose entire mechanism depends on the properties of human memory. Remove memory and spaced-repetition is meaningless — present-tense necessity (Law 8).

friction is a specific kind of resistance — namely, resistance to motion or flow. The specific-to-general direction fits INSTANCE_OF: friction is 'a kind of' resistance, not a part of it (CONTAINS) nor historically prior to it (DERIVED_FROM).
Incentives require scarcity to operate — when resources or status are abundant, the differential payoff that creates an incentive vanishes. Remove scarcity and incentives stop working.
Cognitive offloading requires external tools to transfer mental work — writing, storage media, computation. Without tools there is nothing to offload to; the capacity collapses.

Elaboration as a cognitive learning strategy fundamentally depends on memory: elaboration works by linking new information to existing knowledge structures within a memory system. Without memory as the substrate, elaboration has nothing to elaborate INTO. This is present-tense necessity per Law 8, not chronology.

Mnemonics — techniques like method of loci, peg systems, chunking — operate by leveraging memory structure and encoding strategies. Remove memory and mnemonics cease to function; they are a present-tense necessity, not merely historical. DEPENDS_ON direction: mnemonics needs memory.

Interleaving as a learning technique requires memory systems to function — it works by exploiting memory retrieval and pattern differentiation. Remove memory and interleaving has nothing to operate on.
A colloquialism is an informal expression that exists ONLY within a language system. Remove language and the colloquialism ceases to exist — this is constitutive, not merely facilitative dependency.

An idiom is a fixed expression whose meaning cannot be deduced from its literal components. It cannot exist without language — language is its necessary substrate, not merely a facilitator. Remove language and idioms cease to exist.

A neologism is a newly coined word or expression. It cannot exist without language — it depends on language as its substrate for formation, comprehension, and persistence. The dependency is constitutive: remove language and neologisms cease to function.

retrieval-practice is a learning technique whose definition is constitutively tied to memory — it IS the act of retrieving stored information from memory. Remove the concept of memory and retrieval-practice ceases to exist; there is no retrieval without a memory system to retrieve from.
socks as a designed artifact require memory to persist — the knowledge of how to make them (pattern, knit technique, sizing conventions) must be stored and transmitted across makers and generations.
marginalia is a specific type of annotation — notes written in the margins of a text. The specific points at the general: INSTANCE_OF.
notation requires writing to operate — you cannot produce written notation without the writing system running. Present-tense necessity, not mere history.
french horn is a specific kind of tool — a musical instrument designed by humans to produce sound. Specific→general INSTANCE_OF.
Memorandum is a formal written message — it cannot exist without writing as its substrate and mechanism. Remove writing and the memorandum ceases to operate.

Feedback operates by conveying information about performance, quality, or state. Remove information from the loop and feedback ceases to function — it has nothing to communicate. This is a present-tense dependency, not chronology.
A default is a specific kind of standard — the one that applies in the absence of an explicit choice. 'Default' narrows the general concept of standard to the no-preference case.
Formative assessment requires feedback to operate — without feedback about learner performance, formative assessment cannot function. The dependency is present-tense and constitutive.

A default is a pre-established conventional choice — it requires shared norms communicated and maintained through language. Without language, no convention can be established to designate what counts as a default.

Heuristics are cognitive shortcuts that operate by retrieving stored patterns — a 'recognize-then-act' heuristic needs recognition memory, a take-the-best heuristic needs stored cue validity. Remove memory and heuristics have no patterns to shortcut.
A lexeme is a basic unit of meaning in a language. It constitutively requires language — without language, a lexeme cannot exist or operate. This is present-tense necessity per Law 8.

Exegesis is critical interpretation or explanation of a text. It constitutively requires language — exegesis operates on linguistic texts, parsing semantic and syntactic structure. Without language, exegesis cannot function. Law 8.

Conceptual blending requires simplification of source and target mental spaces to identify structural correspondences. Without simplification — stripping away incidental details to preserve relational patterns — blending cannot operate.

Analogical reasoning maps structure from a known source domain to a target domain. This mapping requires simplification of both domains to their shared relational skeleton. Without simplification, surface features swamp structural correspondences.

Conceptual blending is a cognitive operation that creates new meaning by integrating mental spaces. It constitutively requires working memory (to hold and manipulate multiple spaces simultaneously) and long-term memory access (to retrieve schemas and knowledge). Remove memory — and conceptual blending cannot operate. This is present-tense necessity (Law 8), not historical association.

Simplification as a cognitive/communicative practice needs information to operate — you cannot simplify what there is no information about. The mechanism removes or reduces informational complexity; without the informational substrate the practice has nothing to act upon.

Dual coding works by creating both verbal and visual memory traces. It depends on memory encoding and retrieval systems to operate — without memory, the dual representation has no storage or recall mechanism.

Paraphrase — restating content in different words — cannot operate without language as its substrate. Remove language and paraphrase stops working immediately. Constitutive dependency, not merely facilitative.

A catchphrase is a linguistic construct — a memorable phrase repeatedly used or quoted. Without language as its substrate, no catchphrase can exist or operate. This is constitutive, not merely facilitative.

A pedagogical technique that works by leveraging memory mechanisms — concrete examples only function as teaching tools because memory (the cognitive substrate that stores and retrieves associations) is running and necessary. Remove memory and the technique ceases to operate. This is constitutive, not merely facilitative.

A field-guide functions by mapping features onto a classification system — without a classification framework to reference, there is no structure for identification. The guide is useless if there is nothing to classify into; the dependency is present-tense and constitutive.
A catchphrase is a specific, memorable phrase repeated by individuals or groups. It is a particular kind of language expression, making this INSTANCE_OF (specific→general).

An epilogue is a structural component of a work that depends on language to function — without language there is no epilogue. Language is the substrate through which an epilogue communicates its retrospective framing.

An idiolect is the distinctive speech pattern of an individual speaker. It depends constitutively on language — without language operating now, no idiolect can exist or function. The idiolect is a variation within language, not independent of it.
Mnemonic devices need memory to operate now — their entire purpose is to enhance memory encoding and retrieval. Without memory, mnemonic devices are pointless. Present-tense necessity.

Paratext — the framing apparatus of texts (titles, prefaces, footnotes, marginalia) — requires language to operate. Remove language and paratext cannot signal, orient, or comment. The dependency is present-tense and constitutive, not merely facilitative.

Worked examples — step-by-step model solutions used in pedagogy — require memory (working memory) to operate. The learner must hold the example in memory to compare against their own problem-solving schema. Without memory, worked examples cannot function.

Synecdoche is a figure of speech (part for whole substitution). It is a linguistic construct — language is constitutive of it. Remove language and synecdoche ceases to exist. This is present-tense necessity, not chronology.

An addendum is a textual addition appended to the end of a document after the main text. It is a writing-specific construct — remove writing and there is nothing to add to. Language is constitutive of addendum.

Mise-en-page is the deliberate layout and formatting of text on a page. It is a visual-linguistic construct — without written/textual media arranged spatially, mise-en-page cannot exist. Writing is constitutive.

Code-switching is the practice of alternating between two or more languages in conversation. Without language as its medium, code-switching cannot exist — it operates entirely through linguistic choice. Constitutive dependency on language, not merely facilitative.

Schemata are cognitive frameworks that organize and store knowledge in memory. Remove memory — and schemata cease to function. This is present-tense constitutive dependency, not historical association. Schemata are structured patterns within memory itself.

Constitutive: diglossia is a sociolinguistic state where two languages serve distinct social functions. Remove language and the concept cannot operate — diglossia is fundamentally a language-bound phenomenon.

abridgment DERIVED_FROM writing: the practice of shortening texts presupposes written text exists first and feeds into the concept of abridgment. Writing existed as a practice millennia before abridgment as a literary convention.

Abridgment as a practice of shortening texts depends on writing as its substrate — without writing in operation, abridgment cannot function. Writing is the constitutive substrate that enables the practice to exist.

Deliberate practice is a learning method that requires conscious encoding and retention of information. It depends on memory — without the capacity to store and retrieve procedural knowledge during practice, deliberate practice ceases to function.

Elaborative rehearsal cannot operate without memory — its entire mechanism IS creating memory associations through meaningful linking. Remove memory and the practice ceases to function. Constitutive dependency (Law 8), not merely facilitative.

Recency bias is the cognitive bias where recent memories are more readily recalled. DEPENDS_ON test: can recency bias exist without memory? No — the bias IS a property of how memory works (recent items are more accessible). Memory is constitutive to the phenomenon.

self-explanation is a metacognitive learning strategy that requires memory to operate — you explain what you understood, which presupposes stored knowledge to retrieve and articulate. Remove memory and the strategy collapses.

Elaborative-integration connects new information to existing knowledge structures. It depends on memory to operate — without memory to hold existing knowledge for integration, the process cannot function. Present-tense necessity.

Bricolage is the practice of creating from whatever materials are at hand. It constitutively depends on memory: the bricoleur must remember what materials exist, their properties, and how they've been combined before. Remove memory and the practice stops — you cannot assemble from available means without retaining knowledge of what's available.

A worked example is a pedagogical artifact showing a solved problem step by step. It constitutively depends on memory: the learner must hold the example's steps in working memory and connect them to prior knowledge in long-term memory. Remove memory and worked examples cease to function as learning tools.

Recency bias is the memory phenomenon where recent items are better recalled. It constitutively depends on memory: the bias IS a property of memory ordering. Without memory, there is no recency effect — the dependency is constitutive, not merely facilitative.

Peritext depends on writing to operate — it is the apparatus surrounding a written text (titles, prefaces, margins, colophons) that shapes reader engagement. Remove writing and peritext ceases to exist.

Interleaving practice mixes different topics during learning to improve long-term retention. It is constitutively dependent on memory — the technique works BY exploiting memory encoding and retrieval mechanisms. Without memory as its substrate, interleaving has no effect to optimize.

Desirable difficulties (spacing, interleaving, generation, variability) are learning conditions that enhance retention by imposing productive strain on memory systems. Constitutively dependent on memory — these difficulties only work because they engage memory encoding/retrieval processes. Remove memory and desirable difficulties cease to exist.

Overlearning is the continued practice of a skill after mastery has been achieved. It operates constitutively on memory — overlearning strengthens memory traces through repeated retrieval and consolidation. Remove memory and overlearning cannot function; the effect IS a memory phenomenon.

Zeugma is a rhetorical device where one word governs multiple others in different senses. It operates entirely through language — without language there is no zeugma. The dependency is constitutive, not merely facilitative.

Catachresis is the misapplication of a word to something for which it has no proper name — e.g. 'leg of a table.' This is inherently linguistic: without language, the phenomenon of word-misapplication cannot exist. Language is constitutive, not merely facilitative.

Reification is the cognitive act of treating an abstraction as if it were a concrete entity. This requires memory to hold the abstraction in mind and re-present it as concrete. Remove memory and the mechanism of reification cannot operate.

Aporia is a rhetorical device expressing genuine puzzlement or doubt — it operates within language as its medium and mechanism. Without language, aporia cannot exist or function. The dependency is constitutive: aporia is a pattern of linguistic expression, not merely facilitated by language.

Diacritics are marks added to letters in a writing system. Without writing, diacritics have no existence — they are a feature of written language, not speech. The dependency is constitutive: remove writing and diacritics cease to function.

A subscription is a recurring arrangement requiring an ongoing record of terms, payments, and deliveries. Without record-keeping, a subscription cannot persist or function — each recurrence would need to be renegotiated from scratch.

The ZPD is the gap between what a learner can do alone versus with guidance. Scaffolding — the adjustable support provided by a more knowledgeable other — is the mechanism that makes the ZPD operable. Remove scaffolding and the ZPD ceases to function as a learning construct. This is a constitutive, present-tense dependency.

Reification is the cognitive act of treating an abstraction as if it were concrete. This requires language — the ability to name abstractions and reify them as objects of thought. Without language, there is no capacity to reify. Constitutive dependency on language as the substrate of abstract objectification.
incentive operates through feedback loops — a reward or threat motivates only because the agent receives feedback about consequences; remove feedback and incentive cannot function

Transfer-of-learning is the phenomenon of prior learning affecting new learning. It DEPENDS_ON learning as its substrate — without the capacity for learning, there is nothing to transfer. The dependency is present-tense and constitutive.

Dark-data is data that exists but is inaccessible for analysis (lost formats, corrupted storage, undocumented schemas). It DEPENDS_ON data — dark-data cannot exist without data being the substrate. A subset relationship with dependency.
Transfer-of-learning requires memory to operate — you cannot transfer learned content to a new context without memory retaining that content. Present-tense constitutive necessity per Law 8.

Hearsay (secondhand testimony or information) requires language to transmit — it is fundamentally about conveying claims through verbal or written channels. Without language, there is no hearsay. Constitutive per Law 8.
Hendiadys (using two nouns instead of a noun and its modifier) IS a linguistic figure — it cannot exist or operate without language. Language is its constitutive substrate, not merely a facilitator.
Oxymoron is a linguistic/rhetorical figure combining contradictory terms (e.g. 'deafening silence'). It operates entirely within language — remove language and the construct cannot exist or function.

Knowledge-transformation requires learning to operate — the process of converting information into knowledge and then into new knowledge is itself a learning mechanism. Remove learning and knowledge-transformation cannot function.
Knowledge transformation requires memory to operate: without memory retaining and re-accessing knowledge, no transformation can occur. Present-tense necessity.
Dark data is information that exists but is unused. Without the information substrate running, dark-data cannot exist — it is present-tense necessary, not merely associated.

Reductio ad absurdum is inherently linguistic: it constructs arguments in language that lead to absurdity, using linguistic structure as the mechanism. Remove language and the technique cannot operate — it IS a linguistic operation.
Peroration is a specific type of rhetorical technique — the climactic conclusion of a speech or discourse. 'A peroration is a specific kind of rhetoric' per Law 9.

A shelf is a human-made storage structure designed to hold and organize information-bearing objects (books, records, digital storage). Remove information as a concept — the shelf loses its purpose entirely. Dependency is constitutive.
Reductio ad absurdum requires distinguishing between a proposition and its absurd consequences — the distinction operation is constitutive of the method.
Belief updating is the process of revising mental states — it constitutively depends on distinguishing old beliefs from new evidence and from each other.
hyperbole is a specific kind of rhetorical device — a figure of speech that exaggerates for effect. INSTANCE_OF because hyperbole is a subtype of rhetoric, not merely related to or using it.
Scholium is a brief marginal note — a specific kind of commentary. Scholium INSTANCE_OF commentary follows the specific→general direction.

Seduction requires rhetorical techniques — staged reveals, emotional modulation, performative language — to function. Without rhetoric, seduction loses its mechanism of desire-alignment and collapses into mere presence or force.
Doubt needs the capacity to draw distinctions — you cannot doubt without distinguishing between what is believed and what might be so. Without distinction-making, doubt cannot operate.
A cue as a sign or signal depends on shared language (broadly construed as a sign-system) to function. Without a convention linking cue to meaning, it is just noise, not a cue.
metanoia (perspective transformation, a shift in how one sees the world) is a specific kind of learning — it names the moment of re-framing, a subtype of cognitive change. Specific→general.
A subscription is a specific kind of contract — a recurring agreement where terms renew automatically over time. Specific→general.

prompting requires belief to operate — a prompt only elicits the intended response if the recipient believes the prompt is relevant and the response is expected. Without belief in the causal link between prompt and response, prompting cannot function.

cue requires distinguishing signal from noise, meaning from background. Without the capacity for distinction, a cue cannot function — there is no way to separate the meaningful sign from irrelevant context. DEPENDS_ON is constitutive.

Cue is a signal or stimulus that triggers retrieval from memory. The mechanism only operates because memory exists — a cue has no function without something to cue from. Removing memory eliminates the cue's entire purpose. The dependency is constitutive, not merely historical.

Reductio ad absurdum is a specific kind of logical argument — the method of proving a proposition by showing its contradiction leads to absurdity. This is a clear specific→general INSTANCE_OF relationship.

prompting is the practice of framing communication to elicit a specific response — it needs language to operate now (Law 8). Remove language and prompting collapses; no constitutive dependency otherwise.
Indexical expressions (I, here, now) require language to function — without language there are no indexicals. Present-tense necessity: remove language and the concept of indexicality ceases to exist.
A franchise is a contractual arrangement to operate under another's brand and systems. Remove the contract and the franchise ceases to exist — present-tense constitutive dependency.

A category error is the mistake of assigning an entity to a classification category it does not belong to. Without classification systems, there can be no category errors — the dependency is present-tense and constitutive.

Belief-updating depends on salience as a constitutive mechanism — the cognitive system must flag certain inputs as salient before they can trigger belief revision. Without the salience filter, no input reaches the belief-updating process.
Reductio ad absurdum is a specific form of argumentation that works by demonstrating that a premise leads to an absurd or contradictory conclusion.

Salience (what catches attention) operates by highlighting stimuli against stored knowledge and expectations. Remove memory and the contrast that produces salience vanishes — the dependency is constitutive.
Loss aversion — the tendency to prefer avoiding losses over acquiring equivalent gains — is a specific kind of cognitive bias. Direction is correct: specific → general.

plausibility requires distinction to operate: one must distinguish plausible from implausible, coherent from contradictory. Without the capacity to draw this distinction, plausibility assessment is impossible. Present-tense necessity.

Naming is a specific kind of labeling: it assigns a persistent identifier (a name) to an entity, which is precisely the function of labeling. 'Naming is a specific kind of labeling' — the specific (naming) points at the general (labeling), per Law 9.

The testing effect is the phenomenon whereby active retrieval practice strengthens memory retention. It operates through memory mechanisms — without memory as a substrate, the testing effect cannot exist. This is a constitutive dependency, not merely historical association.
folksonomy needs labeling to operate now — without the capacity to assign labels/tags to items, folksonomic classification cannot function. This is constitutive, not merely facilitative.
concept-maps need categorization to define the nodes being connected
Indexing depends on labeling: you cannot build an index without first labeling items. Labeling is the constitutive substrate — remove it and indexing stops operating immediately.
Transcription depends on notation: the practice of rendering speech in written form requires an existing notation system. Without notation, transcription cannot operate.
A calque is a loan translation — a specific kind of linguistic borrowing where a phrase from one language is translated word-by-word into another. Specific→general INSTANCE_OF.

Labeling requires naming — you cannot label a thing without first having a name for it. Naming provides the token; labeling applies that token to classify. The dependency is present-tense and constitutive.
Recursion is a specific kind of pattern — a self-referential pattern where the output feeds back as input. INSTANCE_OF follows Law 9: specific→general.

Transduction is the conversion of information from one medium or form to another. Writing is constitutive: transduction requires a writable medium to produce output. Without writing as a substrate, transduction cannot complete — it stops at the point of conversion.

Entitlement requires social or institutional recognition to exist — without recognition, a claim is merely a belief or desire, not an entitlement. The present-tense necessity test: remove recognition and entitlement ceases to function as a concept.

base-rate-fallacy is a specific type of cognitive bias — the error of ignoring prior probabilities in favor of specific case information. Clear specific→general. Law 9: the specific points at the general, never the reverse.

A formula is a symbolic representation whose meaning is carried through a notational system. Remove notation — the system of symbols — and formula ceases to operate. This is constitutive, not facilitative: a formula without notation is just ink or marks with no formal meaning.
Toponymy depends on language: place names are linguistic constructs. Without language, there can be no toponymy. Present-tense necessity.

Repertoire — the set of skills, knowledge, and practices available to an individual or community — needs language to operate now. Without language, a repertoire cannot be expressed, transmitted, or maintained. Language is constitutive of repertoire as a human construct.

Transcription is a specific kind of representation — it converts speech, sound, or performance into a written or symbolic form. The specific→general direction holds: transcription IS a particular type of representation. The test: transcription is to representation as shorthand is to writing.

A calque is a loan translation — a phrase rendered word-for-word from one language into another. Remove language and the phenomenon ceases to exist: there is no calque without languages to translate between. This is constitutive, not facilitative — the same standard accepted for toponymy DEPENDS_ON language (toponymy = naming places, requires language).

A concordance cannot function without indexing — its entire purpose is to provide indexed access to word occurrences. Remove indexing and the concordance ceases to work. This is present-tense necessity (Law 8).
A schedule is a mapping of activities to time. Remove the concept of time and a schedule cannot exist or operate — time is the constitutive substrate of scheduling, not merely a related concept.
Indexing needs information to operate now — it literally organizes, catalogs, and structures information. Without information, indexing has nothing to work on. Constitutive present-tense dependency.

Indexing organizes items into retrievable categories; it needs a classification system (taxonomy) to give those categories structure. Remove taxonomy and indexing has no framework — constitutive dependency per Law 8.
Calendars (time-division systems) existed millennia before modern scheduling. Scheduling evolved from the concept of dividing time into segments for allocation — history confirms chronology.

knowledge-bases are structured repositories (databases, wikis, encyclopedias) that depend constitutively on the concept of memory — they are externalized memory architectures. Remove memory and the very idea of knowledge-bases ceases to function.

Scheduling organizes activities across temporal intervals. Without time as a concept (duration, sequence, ordering), scheduling cannot operate — not merely historically associated but constitutively dependent. You cannot schedule without temporal reference.

A repertoire is a collection of mastered techniques. Without practice — the deliberate repetition that builds competence — a repertoire cannot exist. This is present-tense necessity: remove practice and the concept of a repertoire collapses.
dark-data is a specific kind of information — data that exists and has potential value but is inaccessible or unused. The direction is specific→general: dark-data IS a kind of information.

Cognitive strategies — planned mental approaches to learning, problem-solving, and performance — require abstraction to operate: without the capacity to form abstract patterns and generalizations, no strategy can be deployed across situations.
Self-testing (retrieval practice) requires memory to operate: the act of testing recall depends on an existing memory trace to retrieve. Remove memory and self-testing has nothing to retrieve.

Spaced practice requires scheduling to operate: the technique of distributing learning across time intervals depends on scheduling those intervals. Remove scheduling and spaced practice cannot maintain its temporal structure.

Repertoire — the concept of a catalog of available skills and knowledge — requires memory to operate. Without the concept of memory, no repertoire can be defined, tracked, or utilized. The remove-it-now test: remove memory as a concept and repertoire becomes unintelligible.

Incentive structures depend on knowledge-bases: to create effective incentives, one must draw upon knowledge about what motivates behavior. The knowledge-base provides the informational substrate that makes incentives intelligible and targeted.

Burden assessments depend on knowledge-bases: determining what counts as a burden requires reference to established knowledge about capacity, limits, and fairness. The knowledge-base provides the standards against which burden is measured.

Indexing requires categorization as a constitutive substrate — you cannot create an organized index without first grouping items into categories. Remove categorization and indexing ceases to function; an un-categorized list is merely a list, not an index.

A value-proposition only exists within an exchange context — it is the articulated offer of value in return for something. Remove exchange and a value-proposition has no meaning; it is a claim about what someone would accept, not a standalone concept.

Analogical reasoning requires recalling source domain knowledge to map onto target domains. Without memory storing prior knowledge there is no source material to reason from. Present-tense constitutive necessity.
cognitive-strategy requires memory to function — strategies must be encoded, recalled, and applied, all of which depend on memory operations. This is present-tense necessity, not chronology.

transfer-of-training requires memory — you cannot transfer knowledge or skill from one context to another without first having encoded and retained it in memory. Present-tense necessity, not chronology.
stereotype is a specific kind of cognitive strategy: a mental shortcut that categorizes social groups. It fits the pattern X is a specific case of Y, which is always INSTANCE_OF per Law 9.
Representativeness is a specific kind of cognitive bias: it is the prototype-similarity judgment heuristic. INSTANCE_OF is correct — specific→general.

Transduction is the process of converting one form of information into another (sensory signals to neural impulses, etc.). Remove information — there is nothing to transduce, no signal to convert. The dependency is constitutive: transduction IS information-in-motion.

premeditation (deliberate prior planning) constitutively requires memory — you cannot plan ahead without the capacity to recall and project. Remove memory and premeditation stops working entirely, satisfying Law 8's present-tense necessity test.

self-regulated-learning requires memory — you cannot monitor, evaluate, or adjust your own learning without remembering goals, strategies, and outcomes. Remove memory and the capacity for self-regulated learning vanishes (Law 8 test).

procedural-memory is a specific psychological category within the general concept of memory. Law 9: specific→general. Procedural memory IS A KIND of memory (the category of memory for skills and habits).
premeditation is a specific form of forward-thinking that depends on memory. Law 9: specific→general. Premeditation IS A KIND of memory operation (the advance deployment of memory for future action).

Burden is a specific kind of incentive mechanism: a cost or obligation imposed to shape behavior. Both are human-made constructs for steering action, but burden is the specific form that operates through negative pressure rather than positive reward.

Knowledge-bases require language to operate — without the capacity to encode and retrieve symbols, no knowledge-base functions. Language is the constitutive substrate for any stored knowledge structure.

Procedural memory needs reflection to operate: without the capacity to reflect on one's own procedures, procedural memory cannot be monitored, corrected, or consciously accessed. Reflection is the present-tense mechanism by which procedural knowledge becomes inspectable and improvable.

Knowledge-bases — human-made systems for organizing, storing, and retrieving information — constitutively require information as their subject matter. Remove information from the concept and a knowledge-base has nothing to organize. Present-tense necessity confirmed.

Coinage — the human-made system of creating and regulating currency — constitutively requires measurement. Creating coins demands measuring weight, purity, and denomination. Without measurement, there is no coinage. Present-tense necessity confirmed.

A value-proposition — the articulated statement of value offered to a customer — is fundamentally a communicative construct. It requires language to express, negotiate, and persist. Remove language and the value-proposition cannot exist as a concept. Present-tense necessity confirmed.

Stereotypes are cognitive shortcuts that operate on category membership judgments. They depend on categorization being active right now — without the capacity to sort entities into categories, stereotypes cannot function at all. This is present-tense necessity.

Error correction requires comparing an output against reference information to detect and fix deviations. Without information to serve as the ground truth, error correction has nothing to check against and cannot operate.
A heuristic is a specific kind of cognitive strategy — a mental shortcut for fast decisions. INSTANCE_OF: specific→general per Law 9.
A default-effect is a specific kind of cognitive bias — the systematic preference for status-quo options. INSTANCE_OF: specific→general per Law 9.
Scaffolding is a specific kind of pedagogical technique — the specific points at the general. Test: 'scaffolding is a kind of pedagogy' is true.

Anaphora constitutively depends on language — the mechanism of referring back to earlier discourse requires a linguistic system to operate. Remove language and anaphora cannot function. Present-tense necessity, not merely historical association.
A shirt is a specific kind of clothing — worn on the upper body. INSTANCE_OF direction is correct: specific (shirt) → general (clothing). Not a part-of relationship; it IS a kind of clothing.
A skirt is a specific kind of clothing — a garment covering the lower body. INSTANCE_OF direction is correct: specific (skirt) → general (clothing).
A dress is a specific type of clothing worn on the upper body. INSTANCE_OF correctly maps specific→general.
A burden is a specific type of obligation — a weight of duty or responsibility that one owes. INSTANCE_OF correctly maps specific→general.

Script knowledge is a specific type of procedural memory: it is the learned capacity to perform routines and sequences without conscious deliberation. The direction is correct (specific→general). The test: script knowledge IS A KIND OF procedural memory.
Implicature requires language to operate now — without an active linguistic system, no implied meaning can be generated or decoded. The dependency is constitutive, not merely facilitative.

Oracle responses require language as their substrate — an oracle without language cannot convey advice or wisdom. Remove language and the oracle ceases to function. Constitutive present-tense dependency.
An incentive operates by conveying information about consequences — rewards for action, penalties for inaction. Without information, an incentive cannot guide behavior. Constitutive DEPENDS_ON.
The abstraction-ladder is a specific kind of generalization model: it organizes levels of increasing generality. 'A is a specific kind of B' → INSTANCE_OF per Law 9.

hysteresis is a specific abstract concept describing path-dependence in systems. 'Hysteresis is a kind of abstraction' — it is a conceptual model, not a physical thing, abstracting the pattern of history-dependent behavior.
keyboard is a specific kind of tool (input device). Direction tested: keyboard IS A tool, not the reverse. Law 9: specific→general.
wrench is a specific kind of tool (hand tool for gripping/turning). Direction tested: wrench IS A tool, not the reverse. Law 9: specific→general.

Noticing needs meta-cognition to operate now — the intentional, trained aspect of noticing requires monitoring and regulating one's own attentional states, which IS a meta-cognitive act. Remove meta-cognition (awareness of own cognitive processes) and noticing as a deliberate practice cannot function. Law 8 present-tense necessity test satisfied.
noticing requires attention to operate now. One cannot notice without directing attention. Remove attention and noticing ceases to function. Law 8 present tense necessity met.

Metacognition needs noticing to operate now — metacognition IS the noticing of one's own cognitive processes. Remove the capacity for noticing and metacognition stops immediately. This is a constitutive dependency, not merely facilitative.
epistemic-humility is a specific kind of virtue — the virtue of recognizing one's epistemic limits. 'X is a specific kind of Y' is INSTANCE_OF (Law 9).

An errata slip is a textual correction notice — it is constituted by language. Remove language and an errata slip becomes a blank card with no function. This is constitutive dependency, not merely facilitative.

Constraint-satisfaction needs logic to operate now — constraints are logical relations and satisfaction is a logical check. Remove logic and constraint-satisfaction stops working. Present-tense necessity.

A docket is an organized ledger of pending items or cases. Remove the record-keeping function and the docket ceases to operate — it literally cannot function without maintaining records. Present-tense constitutive dependency.

Intention requires holding a future state in mind — this is memory's work. Remove memory and intention cannot form at all: you cannot intend toward a future you cannot recall. Present-tense constitutive dependency, not mere chronology.

A checksum requires an algorithm to operate — the fixed-size digest is produced by applying a deterministic algorithm to input data. Remove algorithms and checksumming becomes impossible. The dependency is constitutive: the algorithm IS the mechanism by which a checksum operates.
A sandal is a specific kind of footwear. Tested: sandal INSTANCE_OF footwear — a sandal IS a footwear, the direction is specific→general per Law 9.
Footwear is a specific kind of clothing — it covers a part of the body (feet) rather than being clothing-free. Direction is specific→general, matching INSTANCE_OF (Law 9).
A dossier depends on having a record-keeping system to store and organize its constituent documents. Without records, a dossier cannot function.
A tally is a record of count. Remove counting and a tally has no mechanism to operate — counting is constitutive, not merely historical or facilitative.
A toponym is a place name. Remove language and names cannot exist — language is constitutive to toponyms, not merely facilitative.
Folk-etymology requires language to operate — it is a process within language where speakers reanalyze word forms. Remove language and the mechanism has no substrate on which to act.
An atlas is physically composed of maps — each map is a part contained within the whole atlas. This is a whole-part relationship, not a kind-of relationship.

Terminology requires language to operate — it is the systematic naming within a field, and without language there can be no names or terms. Remove language and terminology ceases to function. This is constitutive, not merely facilitative.
A preamble is an introductory statement at the start of a document — it IS a linguistic construct. Remove language and a preamble cannot exist at all. This is constitutive, not merely facilitative.
A toponym is a specific kind of name — specifically, a name that designates a place. 'X is a specific kind of Y' is always INSTANCE_OF per Law 9.
which-came-first test: counting (one, two, three) predates systematic chronology. Numerical ordering existed before the institutional practice of arranging events in temporal sequence.

present-tense necessity: an oracle's entire function is to provide answers to questions. Remove questions and the oracle has nothing to do. Constitutive dependency — oracle cannot operate without questions.
Debugging is a specific kind of error-correction — the systematic identification and correction of errors. Remove error-correction and debugging ceases to exist as a practice.
Escrow is a contractual arrangement with a third-party holder. Remove contract and escrow stops working — the mechanism fundamentally requires a binding agreement between parties.
Seduction needs persuasion to operate now — it is an application of persuasive techniques. Remove persuasion and seduction ceases to function.

A rationale is articulated reasoning — remove reasoning as a capacity and practice, and rationale stops existing. A rationale cannot be produced without reasoning operating in the present. The arrow passes the present-tense removal test.

remove law from the system — does liability as a concept stop working? Yes. Liability is a legal construct defining responsibility and obligation; without the framework of law, the concept has no traction. This is constitutive, not merely facilitative.

remove pedagogy (the systematic practice of teaching and education) — does curriculum stop working? Yes. A curriculum is inherently an educational construct: the planned organization of teaching and learning. Without pedagogical intent and structure, you have a syllabus or outline, not a curriculum. The dependency is constitutive.

concordance IS a specific kind of agreement — it denotes mutual harmony and alignment of views or feelings, which is a subset of the general concept of agreement (any mutual arrangement). Removing agreement as a concept would eliminate concordance; concordance is a particular form of agreement characterized by emotional/attitudinal alignment.

Justification needs reasoning to operate now — to provide justification you must actively reason, construct arguments, and link evidence to claims. Remove reasoning and justification collapses; you cannot justify anything without reasoning. This is constitutive, not merely facilitative.

Remove reasoning — does precedence stop working? Yes. Precedence is the concept of establishing priority or order between items, and this requires reasoning to evaluate, compare, and determine which takes precedence. Without reasoning, precedence cannot function. Present-tense constitutive dependency.

Remove language — does folk-psychology stop working? Yes. Folk psychology is the human capacity to attribute mental states to others, and this attribution is articulated and transmitted through language. The conceptual framework of mental state attribution (belief, desire, intention) persists via language — without language, the map of folk psychology ceases to operate. Constitutive, not merely facilitative.

Reciprocity is a specific kind of exchange — mutual give-and-take — while exchange is the general category of any transfer between parties. 'Reciprocity is a specific kind of exchange' is always INSTANCE_OF per Law 9.
Etiquette is a specific kind of social norm — codified rules of polite behavior. Etiquette is a kind of norm, not the other way around. 'X is a specific kind of Y' is always INSTANCE_OF per Law 9.

Rent-seeking as a conceptual construct requires law/institutional frameworks to operate — it is the manipulation of legal/institutional conditions for unearned gain. Remove the legal/institutional framework and rent-seeking as a concept stops being meaningful. Constitutive dependency, not mere facilitation per Laws 8/8a.

Self-efficacy as the psychological construct (per Law 2a — the MAP, not the natural feeling of confidence) requires language to be articulated and transmitted. The theoretical framework of self-efficacy, the ability to reflect on one's own capabilities through linguistic representation, is constitutively dependent on language. Remove language and the concept collapses per Laws 8/8a.

Negligence requires law to operate now — it is a legal concept defined by the breach of a legally recognized duty. Remove law and negligence ceases to exist as a construct. Present-tense necessity: without law, there is no duty, no breach, no negligence.

Prophecy requires language to operate now — it is a communicated prediction, not a raw experience. Without language, prophecy cannot be articulated, transmitted, or recognized as prophecy. Present-tense necessity.

Shorts as a garment concept depends on clothing as a substrate — you cannot have shorts (a category of wearing) without clothing existing as the foundational concept. Remove clothing and shorts ceases to operate as a meaningful category.

Elaboration as a cognitive strategy requires language to generate connective content — examples, analogies, restatements are all linguistic acts. Remove language and the elaboration mechanism cannot operate. Present-tense dependency is constitutive.
taxonomy-of-tasks is a specific kind of taxonomy (a system for organizing tasks). Specific→general per Law 9.
The fiduciary concept requires law to operate now — fiduciary duty is a legal construct with no existence outside legal systems. Remove law and fiduciary ceases to function.
curriculum is expressed through and requires language to operate now — without language there is no curriculum structure, only raw experience
shorts are a specific kind of clothing garment — 'shorts IS A KIND OF clothing' is a straightforward INSTANCE_OF relation per Law 9.

self-efficacy (as the psychological construct per Law 2a) is a specific type of belief — namely, belief in one's own capability. This is a specific→general relationship per Law 9: self-efficacy IS A KIND OF belief.

Proportionality requires measurement to operate now — a proportional relationship is meaningless without the ability to measure quantities. Remove measurement and proportionality cannot function. This is constitutive, not merely historical.

A quantum certificate fundamentally requires cryptographic protocols to function — without encryption, key distribution, and digital signatures, there is no certificate. Remove cryptography and quantum-certification ceases to exist. Constitutive dependency.

Reflection is the conscious examination of past experiences, thoughts, or actions. Remove memory and reflection is impossible — there is nothing to reflect upon. Constitutive present-tense dependency: the act requires the capacity to recall and re-examine.

Reflection is a specific kind of metacognitive practice: it is the focused, sustained examination of one's own thought processes, which is a subset of metacognition (awareness and regulation of cognition more broadly). Specific→general per Law 9.

Remove measurement (quantitative assessment, risk evaluation, verification of facts) — does due diligence stop working? Yes. Due diligence is constituted by measuring risk, verifying claims, and evaluating evidence against standards. Without measurement, there is no due diligence — only guesswork. This is constitutive, not merely facilitative.

Remove awareness — does introspection stop working? Yes. Introspection is directed awareness: the act of turning awareness upon itself. Without awareness as the substrate, introspection cannot operate at all. This is constitutive dependency, not chronological association.
Due diligence is the process of gathering and assessing information before a decision. Remove information and due diligence stops working — the dependency is constitutive, not facilitative.

fiduciary-duty requires the fiduciary relationship to exist now — without the relationship, the duty cannot operate. This is constitutive dependency per Law 8: remove the fiduciary relationship and the duty ceases to have meaning or force.

Puns require language to operate now — they depend on the capacity for multiple meanings, homophones, and linguistic ambiguity. Remove language and puns cease to exist. Present-tense constitutive dependency.
Expertise constitutively depends on memory — without the capacity to retain and recall knowledge, expertise cannot exist. Memory is the substrate on which expertise operates now.

An idiolect requires memory to operate: the individual's vocabulary, grammar, pronunciation, and stylistic patterns must be stored and retrieved for speech to function. Without memory, no idiolect can persist or be expressed.

caution (the practice of being careful to avoid risk or damage) constitutively depends on attention — you cannot be cautious without directing attention toward potential hazards. Remove attention and caution ceases to operate. This is present-tense necessity: the concept of caution requires the attentional capacity as its substrate.

Script is a notational system for encoding spoken language. Remove language and there is nothing for the script to encode — the script ceases to function as a representational system. This is constitutive, not merely facilitative.

Catechism is a method of religious instruction through question-and-answer format. Remove language and the Q&A structure collapses — catechism cannot operate without linguistic exchange. Constitutive dependency, not merely facilitative.
Meme as a unit of cultural transmission depends on memory constitutively — memes persist only through human memory. Without memory as substrate, no meme can exist or propagate.

Test: remove language (the system of conventional spoken/written symbols), does sarcasm stop? Yes. Sarcasm is the gap between literal and intended meaning — a phenomenon that requires language to exist. Without language there is no literal meaning to violate, and thus no sarcasm. This is constitutive, not facilitative.

Self-efficacy (Bandura) is the belief in one's capacity to exercise agency and produce outcomes. Remove the concept of agency and self-efficacy has nothing to anchor to — it is about agency-belief specifically. Present-tense dependency.

Gamification applies game-design elements to non-game contexts. Remove the concept of game and gamification has no referent — it is literally defined as borrowing from games. Present-tense DEPENDS_ON.

Dual-process is a framework describing two modes of thinking (fast/intuitive vs slow/deliberate). It depends on cognition as its substrate — without cognitive processes, there is nothing for the two-process model to describe. Present-tense necessity.

Liminality (the in-between phase of a rite of passage per van Gennep) depends on ritual: remove ritual and liminality has no structure to inhabit. Liminality is defined relationally — it is the transitional state WITHIN ritual. Present-tense necessity, not mere chronology.

Orthography is the conventional visual writing system of a language. Remove writing entirely and orthography collapses — it has no medium in which to operate. The dependency is constitutive: orthography IS writing systematized, not merely facilitated by it.

Epistemic bias is a systematic distortion in how beliefs are formed, evaluated, or revised. Remove belief as a concept and epistemic bias has no domain to operate in — it cannot distort what does not exist. The bias is constitutively tied to the belief formation mechanism.

Etymon (the original word from which a descendant is derived) constitutionally depends on language — you cannot have an etymon without language as the substrate that carries word-origins. Remove language and the concept of etymon collapses.

Coherence is the structural consistency required for meaningful communication. Remove coherence from a message and the message breaks down — the dependency is present-tense and constitutive, not merely facilitative.

A boundary-object is a specific kind of conceptual framework that mediates between social worlds. Specific→general direction. Remove the general category of conceptual frameworks and boundary-objects cease to be a kind of anything — they are defined by their category membership.

Transactive memory is the shared system of knowing who knows what in a group — this requires meta-representational communication (telling others what you know, learning what they know). Remove language and the meta-representational exchange constitutively required by transactive memory stops. This is not facilitative: without language, there is no explicit transactive memory system, only implicit coordination.

Intention as a human concept constitutionally requires cognition — you cannot have the concept of intention without cognitive capacity. Remove cognition and the concept cannot operate. Present-tense necessity.

The CONCEPT of dual-process theory cannot operate without the CONCEPT of cognition — it is a theory ABOUT cognitive architecture (two-system model of mental processing). Remove cognition and dual-process-theory loses its entire domain and explanatory target.
Mindfulness as a practiced concept requires cognitive capacity to operate — attention, awareness, and metacognition are the substrate without which the practice cannot function.

Dossiers are collections of documented information organized about a person, topic, or event. They depend on language for their content — every dossier entry is written in language. Remove language and dossiers cease to exist as structured records.
Gestalt is a specific conceptual framework for understanding perception and cognition as structured wholes — a particular kind of general conceptual framework.

Taxonomization is the systematic practice of creating taxonomies. Remove classification (systematic arrangement of entities into categories) and taxonomization has no operative mechanism — it IS the practice of classification, making the dependency constitutive, not merely facilitative.

Memetics (the theory that cultural units called memes propagate through cognitive mechanisms) depends on cognition — memes are transmitted, retained, and modified only via human cognitive processes. Remove cognition and memetics has no transmission medium. This is constitutive, not merely facilitative. Direction: specific theory (memetics) depends on substrate (cognition).
rent-seeking requires measuring opportunity costs and distinguishing legitimate profit from unearned gain — the concept depends on measurement to quantify costs, benefits, and the gap between them.

mimesis as a cultural-transmission concept requires language for memes to replicate and be shared. The map of mimesis — how humans imitate and transmit cultural patterns — depends on language as the substrate of transmission.

traditions persist only through memetic transmission — the replication of cultural units across generations. Without meme propagation, traditions dissolve. This is a present-tense DEPENDS_ON: remove memetic transmission and traditions cease to exist.

Scaffolding as a pedagogical construct depends on language. Scaffolding is the temporary support structure provided during learning, gradually removed as competence increases. The concept requires language to be articulated (the support is communicated), taught (students must understand the framework), and faded (verbal cues guide the withdrawal). Remove language and scaffolding cannot exist as a recognized educational practice.

Credentialism — the over-reliance on formal credentials as markers of ability and worth — depends on bureaucracy. Credentials only carry social power within bureaucratic systems that sort and classify people. Without bureaucratic institutions to enforce credential-based gatekeeping, credentialism cannot operate.

Communication as a human practice requires intentionality. Remove intention — the speaker/writer no longer means anything — and communication collapses into mere signal emission. Gricean implicature, speech act theory, and pragmatics all presuppose the intentionality that intention provides.

Ritual, especially rites of passage, depends on the liminal concept. Van Gennep's three-stage model (separation-liminality- incorporation) makes liminality constitutive: without the liminal phase, ritual cannot accomplish its transformative function. Remove liminality and ritual is just routine.

Language as a living system depends on vernacular forms. Vernacular (everyday spoken usage) is the substrate that keeps language alive and evolving — remove vernacular and language becomes a dead, archival system. Spoken vernacular predates written language and sustains it.
The straw-man is a specific type of fallacious reasoning where one misrepresents an opponent's argument to make it easier to attack. 'X is a specific kind of Y' → INSTANCE_OF.
