Information architecture's core function is organizing information through classification. Remove classification — the act of categorizing — and info arch stops operating. Present-tense constitutive dependency.

An interoperability protocol needs standards to operate — it defines rules for systems to interoperate, built on agreed standards. Remove standards and interoperability protocols have nothing to standardize. Constitutive present-tense dependency.

Scarcity is a specific economic concept describing limited availability relative to desire. A competent speaker would call scarcity 'a concept' in economics — it is a kind of conceptual category, not a property or tool.

Homeostasis (a regulatory mechanism maintaining internal balance) needs feedback loops to operate. Remove feedback — the mechanism by which systems monitor outputs and compare against set points to make corrections — and homeostatic regulation stops working entirely. No feedback, no comparison, no correction.

An aphorism is a specific kind of figure-of-speech — a concise, stylistically crafted statement that expresses a truth about the human condition. A competent speaker would describe an aphorism as a form of concise expression. The note pins 'figure-of-speech' in its broad sense: any crafted use of language that goes beyond plain denotation.

aphorism is a specific kind of rhetorical-device — a concise, crafted statement expressing truth. A competent speaker would describe an aphorism as 'a rhetorical device.' The pinned sense is 'statement as rhetorical device' (not 'figure of speech' which requires non-literal language subversion).

scarcity is the condition of limited value relative to demand. Remove value from the picture — no valuation, no 'limited' — and scarcity has no operation. The removal test passes: without value, scarcity cannot function as a concept.

Obfuscation is a specific kind of deception: it conceals meaning or information deliberately. A competent speaker describes obfuscation as 'a form of deception.' Direction specific→general is correct per Law 9.

Systema-constructum is a specific kind of taxonomy — a living, protocol-enforced network of entries and edges mapping human-made constructs. A competent speaker would call it 'a taxonomy.' Direction specific→general, pinned sense: taxonomy-as-protocol-enforced-network.

Aesthetic is a specific kind of concept — a framework for evaluating beauty and artistic quality. A competent speaker calls aesthetics 'a concept' in philosophy and art theory. Direction specific→general, pinned sense: aesthetic as evaluative concept.

Homeostasis is a specific kind of concept — a biological and psychological concept describing self-regulatory processes that maintain stability. A competent speaker would call it a concept in biology/psychology. Direction is specific→general per Law 9.

Aesthetic as a human-made concept requires perception to operate: aesthetic evaluation is the capacity to judge sensory experience, and without perception there is no sensory material to evaluate. Removal test: remove perception — aesthetic loses its entire domain of operation (sensory judgment) and ceases functioning as a concept. This is constitutive, not incidental: aesthetic is defined by its relation to perceptual experience.

Quantum ethics is a specific kind of ethics focused on moral considerations arising from quantum technologies and their societal impact. A competent speaker would call it 'a kind of ethics.' Direction is specific→general per Law 9.

Knowledge-organization needs information to operate right now — remove information and knowledge-organization has nothing to organize; its entire function collapses. Direction tested: which-came-first is not the test here; the removal test passes. Knowledge-organization as a practice requires information as its substrate.

An adage is a traditional, time-tested maxim — a terse expression of general truth accepted by communal use. Direction tested: adage (specific, culturally vetted) → maxim (general category of pithy truth-bearing utterances). Specific→general per Law 9.

A misconception is a specific kind of belief — one that diverges from established evidence. Direction: specific→general per Law 9. A competent speaker would call a misconception 'a (false) belief.' Note: pins the sense of misconception as a cognitive state (not the process of misconceiving), which aligns with its accepted definition as 'a category for a belief.'

Parallax is the apparent displacement of an object when viewed from different angles. Removal test (Law 8): remove perspective and parallax cannot operate — there is no displacement without different viewpoints to observe it from. This is a real operating dependency, not just sayability. Parallax literally requires perspective to function.

Heuristics are practical problem-solving shortcuts that operate by recognizing patterns. Removal test (Law 8): remove pattern-recognition and heuristics cannot function — they are shortcut judgments that require recognizing recurring patterns to apply the right shortcut. This is a real operating dependency.

A placeholder is a stand-in for content that is missing or pending. Its entire function is to carry a slot for information. Remove information and a placeholder has no purpose — it stops operating as a placeholder and becomes just a word. Present-tense constitutive dependency per Law 8.

Systema_constructum_v2 is a taxonomy of constructs — it needs the taxonomy concept to operate. Remove taxonomy and the systematic classification framework cannot function. Direction tested: taxonomy is older/more foundational. Present-tense dependency per Law 8.

Removal test (Law 8): remove the concept of norm and error cannot operate — error is the deviation from an expected standard. Without a norm to deviate from, the concept of error has no working mechanism. Object-level dependency, not meta-level.

Mores is a specific kind of norm — one distinguished by its moral charge and strong social enforcement. Direction tested: mores is a narrower concept than norm (which includes taboos, laws, etiquette, and customs). Mores INSTANCE_OF norm is specific→general (Law 9). Remove norms and mores ceases to operate as a category of behavioral standards.

Epigram depends on vocabulary for its operation: it manipulates word choice, brevity, and wit within a linguistic vocabulary. Remove vocabulary and the epigram mechanism collapses — there is no word-level manipulation without words to manipulate.

An epigram is a specific kind of rhetorical device — a terse expression delivering pointed observation through word economy. Direction: epigram (specific) → rhetorical-device (general). Sense pinned: epigram as a figured speech construct, per its accepted definition.

A placeholder operates as a slot or marker for information. Remove the concept of information and a placeholder collapses — it becomes an empty symbol with no purpose. Object-level removal test: placeholder-as-information-marker stops operating without information.

Scaffold is a specific kind of tool: an artifact that extends human capacity for building and organizing. Per Law 11c, passive artifacts (shelves, jars, walls) qualify as tools exactly as active implements do. A scaffold extends human structural capacity. Direction: scaffold (specific) → tool (general). A competent speaker would say 'a scaffold is a kind of tool.'

A paradigm-shift is a specific kind of conceptual change event — when one conceptual framework is replaced by another. Direction: paradigm-shift (specific) → concept (general). A competent speaker would say 'a paradigm shift is a type of conceptual transformation.' The sense pinned: paradigm-shift as a theoretical construct from the history of science, not the natural occurrence of change.

A cognitive map is a specific kind of mental model: it represents an individual's organized understanding of spatial and relational knowledge. Direction: cognitive-map (newer, specific) → mental-model (older, general). A competent speaker would call a cognitive map 'a mental model'.

Prompt engineering is a specific methodology for systematically designing, testing, and optimizing natural language prompts to elicit desired outputs from AI models. Direction: prompt-engineering (newer, specific) → methodology (older, general). A prompt engineer practices a structured methodology, not just ad hoc tricks.

Ethical AI is a specific subfield of ethics concerned with the moral dimensions of AI development, deployment, and governance. Direction: ethical_ai (newer, specific) → ethics (older, general). It applies ethical frameworks to a concrete domain — a recognized branch within ethics.
Diagnosis requires the concept of error to operate — it identifies what has gone wrong. Remove error and diagnosis has nothing to identify. Present-tense dependency test passes.

Superstition fundamentally requires the concept of causation — it is the false attribution of causal power to coincidental events. Remove causation and superstition has nothing to misapply. Present-tense dependency passes.

Systema Constructum as a taxonomy platform depends on blockchain for its consensus, record-keeping, and coin mechanisms. Remove blockchain and the platform ceases to operate as designed. Present-tense dependency passes.

An invariant is a specific kind of property — one that is preserved under specified transformations. Direction tested: invariant (newer, specific construct) → property (older, general concept). A competent speaker would call an invariant a kind of property.

Direction tested: ekphrasis is a specific rhetorical practice (vivid verbal description of visual art), rhetoric is the general discipline. A competent speaker would call ekphrasis 'a form of rhetoric.' This files the nearest kind — ekphrasis IS a specific kind of rhetoric.

Ekphrasis operates by representing a visual work through verbal description. Remove representation as a mechanism and ekphrasis loses its means of operation — it cannot represent without the concept of representation. Present-tense removal test passes.

Superstition is a specific kind of belief — one founded on false causal attribution without evidence. Direction tested: specific→general. A competent speaker would call superstition 'a kind of belief' (specifically, an unjustified belief). Law 9 INSTANCE_OF satisfied.

Modeling is a specific kind of simulation — it creates a representation to stand in for and operate on a target system. Direction tested: modeling (newer/specific epoch 0.04) → simulation (older/general epoch 0.01). A competent speaker calls modeling 'a type of simulation.' Law 9 INSTANCE_OF satisfied.

Taxonomy operates through categories; remove the concept of categories and taxonomy stops functioning. Which-came-first test: category predates taxonomy (categories are more fundamental). Object-level dependency, not meta-level.

Economics studies allocation of scarce resources. Per the removal test (Law 8): remove scarcity and economics ceases to operate — without scarcity, resource allocation is abundance management, not economics. The discipline's entire subject-matter is the tension between limited means and competing ends.

An analog is a specific kind of representation — one where structural/functional similarity maps between domains. Per Law 9, a competent speaker calls an analog 'a representation.' Direction tested: specific (analog) → general (representation). The filer's scope confirms it is a representation type.

A constraint is a boundary enforced by rules. Per the removal test (Law 8): remove rules and constraints cease to operate — without rules to define and enforce boundaries, there are only natural limits, not constraints. Constraints exist because rules delimit possibility.

Simulation operates by running models — remove the concept of model and simulation ceases to function, as there would be no constructed representation to execute or test. Removal test (Law 8) passes: simulation needs model running now. Object-level: the mechanism of simulation (running a constructed representation to observe outcomes) requires model as its substrate. Direction tested: model is the general concept, simulation is its application — but dependency, not kind-of.

Ontological security is the confidence in continuity of self-identity and the regularity of social environment. Per removal test (Law 8): remove identity and ontological security ceases to operate — the mechanism it describes (stabilizing confidence in self-continuity) has nothing to stabilize. This is object-level, not meta-level: ontological security operates ON identity as its target, not merely as a concept needing language to be said.

Diagnosis operates by applying domain knowledge to identify patterns in observations. Remove knowledge and diagnosis ceases to operate — without domain knowledge, there is no basis for pattern recognition, differential diagnosis, or clinical judgment. Passes Law 8 removal test: diagnosis needs knowledge to function at the object level.

A placeholder is a stand-in that holds a position for information to fill. Remove information and the placeholder has no purpose — it becomes merely an empty marker with no function. Passes Law 8 removal test: placeholders need information to be meaningful constructs.

A mnemonic device is a technique/artifact that requires the capacity for memory to operate. Removal test: remove memory and the mnemonic-device stops working — there is nothing for the device to aid. The device exists to extend memory, but extension requires the faculty it extends.

mnemonic-device INSTANCE_OF artifact. Direction tested: mnemonic-device is newer/specific, artifact is older/general. A mnemonic device is a specific kind of artifact — an object or technique created to aid memory. A competent speaker would call a mnemonic device 'an artifact'. Direction: mnemonic-device → artifact.

algorithmic-governance INSTANCE_OF governance. Direction tested: algorithmic-governance is newer/specific, governance is older/general. Algorithmic governance is a specific kind of governance — decision-making mediated through algorithms. A competent speaker would call algorithmic governance 'a form of governance'. Direction: algorithmic-governance → governance.

Direction tested: mnemonic-device is newer/specific, tool is older/general. A mnemonic device is a specific kind of tool — an artifact created to extend the human capacity for memory. Law 9: 'a mnemonic device is a tool.' Law 11c: tool is a broad sense that absorbs passive artifacts; mnemonic devices are active cognitive artifacts.

Direction tested: cognitive-map is newer/specific, model is older/general. A cognitive map is a specific kind of model — a representational structure that maps spatial or conceptual relationships in the mind. Law 9 satisfied: a competent speaker would call a cognitive map 'a model.'

Direction tested: cognitive-model is newer/specific, model is older/general. A cognitive model IS a model — it is a specific kind of representational model formalizing how people think and make decisions. Law 9: 'a cognitive model is a model.'

Direction tested: folkway is newer/specific, norm is older/general. A folkway IS a norm — it is a specific kind of social norm defined by the absence of moral weight (contrast: mores). A competent speaker would call a folkway a 'norm' of everyday conduct. Law 9 satisfied.

Direction tested: folkway is newer/specific, custom is older/general. A folkway IS a specific kind of custom — it is a customary pattern of behavior, distinguished by its lack of moral weight (contrast: tabu/ritual). A competent speaker would call a folkway 'a custom'. Law 9 applies.

Signaling is a specific kind of communication: it is the act of conveying information through observable signals rather than direct statements. A competent speaker would call signaling 'a form of communication.' Direction: specific (signaling) → general (communication) per Law 9.

Schema is a cognitive structure for organizing information. Remove memory and schemas cannot be stored, retrieved, or operated. Present-tense removal test: no memory → no operative schema. Schema as a construct requires the memory construct to function.

Mindset is a disposition shaped by experience and belief. Remove learning and mindsets cannot be formed or updated — learning is the mechanism by which experiences become structured dispositions. Present-tense removal test: no learning → no operative mindset formation.

Heuristic is a specific kind of rule — a practical rule-of-thumb for decision-making under uncertainty. Law 9: specific→general. A competent speaker calls a heuristic 'a rule (of thumb).' Direction: heuristic IS rule, not the reverse.

Direction tested: remove symbol — does signaling stop OPERATING? Yes. Signaling requires symbolic signs to carry meaning from sender to receiver; remove the symbol system and signaling ceases to function as a mechanism. Law 8, 8b.

A routine is a specific kind of pattern — a repeated sequence of actions performed in a characteristic way over time. A competent speaker would call a routine 'a pattern of behavior.' Law 9: specific→general. The edge direction is routine IS pattern, not the reverse.

A placeholder is a specific kind of representation — it stands in for something else (often absent or unknown content). A competent speaker would call a placeholder 'a form of representation.' Law 9: specific→general. Direction: placeholder IS a representation.

Understatement IS a specific kind of rhetoric — deliberately representing something as less significant than it is, to achieve a rhetorical effect. A competent speaker calls understatement 'a rhetorical device.' Law 9.

Direction tested: mindset is a specific kind of mental-model. A mindset IS a structured way of thinking — a particular kind of mental model that shapes interpretation and response. A competent speaker calls a mindset 'a way of thinking / a mental framework.' Law 9: specific→general.

A constraint is a specific kind of boundary — it delineates what is permitted versus prohibited within a domain. A competent speaker would call a constraint 'a boundary (on what can happen).' Law 9: specific→general.

Direction tested: taxonomy needs ontology to operate — taxonomy classifies entities into kinds, which requires an underlying ontological framework defining what kinds exist. Remove ontology (the notion of kinds/categories) and taxonomy stops operating: it cannot classify without some theory of what kinds there are to classify.

Direction tested: a boundary condition IS a constraint — it constrains the operating limits of a system to a specific range. A competent speaker calls a boundary condition 'a type of constraint.' Law 9: specific→general.

Direction tested: cognitive-architecture IS a specific kind of cognitive-model. A cognitive architecture (ACT-R, SOAR, etc.) is a comprehensive computational model of the structure of cognition — it is a particular type of cognitive model, distinguished by its systematic coverage of multiple cognitive functions. A competent speaker would call a cognitive architecture 'a type of cognitive model.'

A palindrome IS a linguistic phenomenon — a word/phrase that reads the same backwards and forwards. Remove language and palindromes cease to exist as operational constructs. Object-level dependency: the phenomenon requires language as its substrate, not just as a meta-level naming tool.

A cognitive map IS a specific kind of knowledge-representation. It is a structured internal representation that organizes information about spatial and conceptual relationships — a particular type of how knowledge is represented. Direction tested: cognitive-map is the specific, knowledge-representation is the general. Law 9.

The status quo IS a specific kind of convention — it is the conventional arrangement of conditions that a group maintains as the default state. A competent speaker would describe it as 'a type of convention' governing what counts as normal. Direction tested: status quo is the specific, convention is the general. Law 9.

Direction tested: quantum-safe cryptography IS a specific kind of cryptography — it is cryptographic algorithms and protocols designed to operate securely against attacks by quantum computers. A competent speaker would call it a type of cryptography. Law 9: specific to general.

Direction tested: allegory IS a specific kind of metaphor — an extended metaphor expressed through narrative, characters, or events. A competent speaker would call allegory a type of metaphor. Nearest kind.

Direction tested: remove memory and cognitive maps stop operating — they are organized knowledge about spatial and conceptual relationships, and without memory capacity they cannot store, retrieve, or maintain those relationships. Object-level dependency, not meta-level.

Direction tested: cognitive map IS a specific kind of cognitive-model. It is a structured internal representation organizing spatial and conceptual relationships — a particular type of cognitive model. Nearest kind.

Direction tested: remove interpretation and signs stop operating — a sign without an interpreter is merely a physical mark or sound, not a functioning sign. Signs require someone to read them as standing for something beyond themselves. Object-level dependency, not meta-level.

Direction tested by removal: remove narrative and allegory stops operating — allegory IS extended storytelling through events/characters. Without narrative capacity, allegory cannot function. This is constitutive, not meta-level.

Direction tested by removal: remove categorization and ontology stops operating — ontology IS a system for organizing knowledge into categories. Without categorization capacity, ontology cannot function. This is constitutive, not meta-level.

Direction tested: ethical_ai is a specific kind of framework — a structured set of principles, guidelines, and procedures for ensuring AI systems are developed and deployed ethically. Nearest kind. A competent speaker would describe ethical_ai as a framework.

Direction tested: rubric IS a specific kind of framework — a structured set of criteria for evaluation. A rubric provides a framework for consistent assessment. A competent speaker would call a rubric 'a kind of evaluation framework'. Nearest kind.
Direction tested: index IS a specific kind of catalog — a catalog of terms mapped to locations within a work. A competent speaker would call an index 'a kind of catalog'. Nearest kind.

Direction tested: icon needs cognitive-map to operate now — an icon's function is to represent through resemblance, and resemblance only works when the viewer has a cognitive map to interpret it. Remove cognitive mapping and icons stop communicating. A competent speaker recognizes icons as needing mental models to function.

Direction tested: schema needs cognitive-map to operate now — a schema is a structured framework for organizing information, and it relies on cognitive mapping to structure and apply that information. Without cognitive mapping capacity, schemas cannot function as organizational structures.

Direction tested: allegory needs narrative to operate now — an allegory is fundamentally a narrative with hidden or secondary meaning. Remove narrative and allegory collapses into incoherence; it cannot function as a mode of meaning without the narrative structure that carries it.

Removal test: provenance tracks the origin and sequence of events for an object or work — without chronology (ordered temporal sequencing), provenance has no way to represent the lineage. This is not merely using chronology: provenance IS a chronology applied to objects' histories. Remove chronology and provenance collapses into an unordered list of events.

TEST: specific→general. An SOP is a specific kind of protocol — a documented procedure specifying exact steps for routine operations. A competent speaker would call an SOP 'a protocol.' Direction: SOP (specific) → protocol (general).

TEST: specific→general. A framework is a specific kind of schema — a structured set of assumptions and concepts that organizes thinking in a domain. A competent speaker would call a framework 'a schema.' Direction: framework (specific) → schema (general).

Cognitive maps are internal representations of knowledge/space that operate by organizing and retrieving stored information. Remove memory (the capacity to store and recall) and cognitive maps cease to function — they cannot encode, maintain, or access the mapped relationships. This is operational, not merely sayable.

An emblem operates by conveying meaning through symbolic representation. Remove symbols and emblems lose their mechanism of communication — an emblem is meaningless without the symbolic system it draws on. Operational dependency: emblems cannot function without the symbolic capacity.

cognitive-strategy is a specific kind of strategy — a strategy applied to cognitive processes. Direction: cognitive-strategy (specific) → strategy (general). A competent speaker calls a cognitive strategy 'a strategy.' Law 9.

Credential is a specific kind of warrant: a document or token that warrants (authorizes) identity or access. A competent speaker would call a credential 'a warrant' in the authorization sense. Direction: credential (specific) → warrant (general). Law 9.

mind-map is a specific kind of cognitive map — both are human-made representations that organize knowledge spatially/structurally. A mind-map uses nodes and branches to visualize cognitive structure. Direction: mind-map (specific) → cognitive-map (general). Law 9 satisfied.

naming-convention is a specific kind of convention — a convention that governs how names are formed and used. A competent speaker calls a naming convention 'a convention.' Direction: naming-convention (specific) → convention (general). Law 9 satisfied.

jurisprudence is a specific kind of law — the philosophy, theory, and systematic study of law. A competent speaker calls jurisprudence 'a body of law' in the theoretical sense. Direction: jurisprudence (specific) → law (general). Law 9 satisfied.

Remove authentication and credential stops operating — a credential cannot authenticate without the authentication mechanism. This passes the removal test: credential needs authentication running now to perform its function.

sensemaking is a specific kind of interpretation: the process of constructing meaning from experience or ambiguous information. A competent speaker would describe sensemaking as 'a form of interpretation' — it takes raw data/experience and interprets it into meaningful understanding. Direction: specific (sensemaking) → general (interpretation).

compliance needs rules to operate now — remove rules and compliance stops working entirely. The removal test is satisfied: without rules, there is nothing to comply with. This is a present-tense operational dependency, not a historical association.

A warrant needs law to operate — remove law and a warrant loses all force and meaning. This is present-tense operational dependency: the warrant's function is to authorize actions under legal authority, and without law that function ceases.

A knowledge-base needs a symbolic encoding system to operate — remove language (vocal, gestural, or written symbols) and the knowledge-base cannot store, retrieve, or communicate any information. It stops functioning entirely.

A mandate is a formal authoritative command that needs legal backing to operate — remove law and a mandate has no enforcement mechanism or authority, becoming merely words. Without law it cannot compel compliance.

A paradigm is a specific kind of conceptual framework — a paradigm IS a framework for understanding that sets parameters, assumptions, and methods. A competent speaker calls a paradigm 'a framework' (Law 9a test). Direction: specific (paradigm) → general (framework).

Certification is a specific kind of credential — a certification IS a credential that attests to demonstrated competence or completed training. A competent speaker would call certification 'a credential' (Law 9a test). Direction: specific (certification) → general (credential).

A protocol is a specific kind of procedure — a formalized, standardized procedure governing interaction between parties or systems. A competent speaker calls a protocol 'a procedure' (Law 9a test). Direction: specific (protocol) → general (procedure).

A standard is a specific kind of rule — a formally established norm or requirement serving as a measure, benchmark, or criterion. A competent speaker calls a standard 'a rule' (Law 9a test). Direction: specific (standard) → general (rule).

Ratification is a specific kind of procedure — a formal process of giving official approval or consent. Law 9a: a competent speaker would call ratification a (formal approval) procedure. Direction: specific (ratification, epoch 0.71)→general (procedure, epoch 0.25).

A mnemonic IS a specific kind of cognitive tool — it is a technique or device designed to augment memory, a cognitive capacity. Direction: specific (mnemonic) → general (cognitive tool). Law 9a: a competent speaker would call a mnemonic 'a cognitive tool'.

A cognitive tool IS a specific kind of tool — an artifact that extends a human capacity, per the kingdom's broad sense of 'tool.' Direction: specific (cognitive tool) → general (tool). Law 11c: universality is mass, not a forbidden edge; passive and active artifacts alike qualify.

A cognitive tool extends or augments a cognitive capacity by representing knowledge in structured form — technique, framework, or artifact. Remove knowledge-representation and cognitive tools stop functioning: they cannot extend capacity without representing knowledge. Present-tense operational dependency (Law 8), not historical chronology.

A mind map organizes information hierarchically around a central concept — this requires schema (structured knowledge frameworks) to function. Remove schema and mind maps lose their organizing mechanism. Present-tense operational dependency (Law 8).

A heuristic IS a specific kind of cognitive tool — a practical method or mental shortcut designed to extend problem-solving capacity. Direction: specific (heuristic) → general (cognitive tool). A competent speaker calls a heuristic 'a cognitive tool' (Law 9a test). Direction: specific → general.

Codification organizes rules or knowledge into a systematic code — it needs classification (categorizing items into groups) to operate. Remove classification and codification cannot organize; the removal test passes. Present-tense dependency, not historical.

Nomenclature is a system of names for items in a domain — it needs classification (established categories) to operate. Remove classification and there are no categories to name. Present-tense dependency passes the removal test.

knowledge-base IS a specific kind of tool — an artifact that stores and organizes information to extend human memory and reasoning capacity. Law 9a: a competent speaker would call a knowledge base 'a tool' in the broad sense of an artifact extending human capacity. Direction: specific (knowledge-base) → general (tool).

Direction specific→general. A cognitive map IS a specific kind of cognitive tool — an artifact extending memory, a cognitive capacity. A competent speaker would call a cognitive map 'a cognitive tool'. Law 9.

encyclopedia IS a specific kind of knowledge-base: a structured reference work organizing information across domains for retrieval and reference. Direction: specific (encyclopedia) → general (knowledge-base). Law 9 satisfied — a competent speaker calls an encyclopedia a knowledge base.

wiki IS a specific kind of knowledge-base: a collaborative hypertext system where multiple authors create, edit, and hyperlink content with version tracking. Direction: specific (wiki) → general (knowledge-base). Law 9 satisfied.

Imprimatur IS a specific kind of decree — a formal authorization issued as an official order to permit publication/production. Direction specific→general, pinned to Law 9 sense. A competent speaker would call an imprimatur a decree (of approval). The note tests direction: imprimatur came later than the general concept of decree.

accountability as a social institution requires measurement mechanisms (records, metrics, verification) to function. Remove measurement and accountability loses its ability to verify claims — it stops operating, not merely stops being sayable.

accreditation is a specific kind of certification (Law 9). Direction tested: accreditation is newer (epoch 0.71) than certification (0.17), and a competent speaker would call accreditation a type of certification. The specific points at the general.
bylaw is a specific kind of rule (Law 9). Direction tested: bylaw (epoch 0.83) is newer than rule (0). A competent speaker would call a bylaw a type of rule — the specific points at the general.

semantic-web is a specific approach to structuring web data for machine interpretation — it IS a form of knowledge representation. Direction: semantic-web (epoch ~2001) is newer than knowledge-representation (much older). A competent speaker would call the semantic web 'a form of knowledge representation.'

A rule of thumb is a specific kind of heuristic (Law 9). Direction: rule-of-thumb is newer (epoch ~0.90s) than heuristics (epoch ~0.83s). A competent speaker would call a rule of thumb 'a heuristic' — it is a practical, approximate guide for problem-solving, which is exactly what a heuristic is.

A rule of thumb needs practice (repeated engagement) to function — it is derived from accumulated practical experience (Law 8). Remove practice, and the rule of thumb loses its foundation and stops operating as a guide. The removal test passes: without the practice that generates it, a rule of thumb has no basis.

storytelling IS a specific kind of communication (Law 9). Communication is the general category of conveying meaning; storytelling is a specific mode that conveys meaning through narrative structure. A competent speaker calls storytelling a form of communication. Direction correct: communication (epoch ~0.01) predates storytelling (epoch ~0.60s).

oversight needs accountability to operate as a governance mechanism (Law 8). Remove accountability and oversight loses its function — watching without someone being answerable is mere surveillance, not oversight. The removal test: without accountability relationships, oversight mechanisms have no purpose and stop functioning as intended.

quantum_computing needs mathematics to operate (Law 8). Quantum computation is literally the application of mathematical formalism — Hilbert spaces, linear algebra, unitary operators, tensor products — to information processing. Remove mathematics and quantum computing collapses entirely: there is no formalism, no algorithms, no computation. The removal test is absolute: without mathematics, quantum computing ceases to function.

collaborative-editing needs version-control to operate now (Law 8). When multiple people edit the same document simultaneously, version-control manages concurrent changes, resolves conflicts, and tracks history. Remove version-control and collaborative-editing collapses into data loss and edit conflicts — it stops working as a practice.

peer-review needs communication to operate now (Law 8). The entire mechanism runs on communication: reviewers write evaluations, authors revise responses, editors mediate. Remove communication and peer-review cannot function — there is no way to convey judgments or revisions.

peer-review IS a specific kind of institution (Law 9). A peer-review system is an organized social structure with established roles, procedures, and norms for evaluating work — it fits the definition of an institution as a persistent human-made social arrangement.

ordinance IS a specific kind of law (Law 9). An ordinance is a rule or law enacted by a governing body, typically at a local or municipal level. A competent speaker would call an ordinance a type of law. Direction: law is the general category, ordinance is a specific type enacted by specific authorities.

accountability DEPENDS_ON sanction (Law 8). Remove sanctions — the threat or application of consequences — and accountability ceases to operate as a mechanism. Without sanction, accountability is mere assertion with no enforcement. The removal test passes: no sanctions, no accountability. This is object-level, not meta-level (Law 2b).

Collaborative editing IS a specific kind of communication — it is a structured mode of exchanging information through simultaneous document modification. A competent speaker would call collaborative editing 'a form of communication.' Passes Law 9 INSTANCE_OF test. Direction: communication (general) ← collaborative-editing (specific).

Storytelling IS a specific kind of narrative — it is the structured conveyance of events through deliberate narrative technique (plot, character, tension). A competent speaker would call storytelling 'a form of narrative.' Passes Law 9 INSTANCE_OF. Direction: narrative (general) ← storytelling (specific).

Rules of thumb DERIVED_FROM practice — they were historically created from accumulated practical experience. Which came first? Practice (repeated engagement with problems) predates any individual rule of thumb. Practice fed into the creation of rules of thumb as distilled heuristics. Passes Law 7 DERIVED_FROM test.

folklore IS a specific kind of narrative. Narrative is the general category of conveyed events/stories; folklore is the traditional narrative passed through generations within a culture. Direction: specific→general.

abstraction-layer IS a specific kind of abstraction — it is a deliberate grouping of complexity behind a simplified interface. A competent speaker calls it 'an abstraction' used in engineering and computing. Direction: specific→general. This is the nearest kind since abstraction-layer is a concrete instantiation of the general concept of abstraction.

Remove communication and collaborative editing stops operating — it is fundamentally about multiple participants exchanging information through simultaneous document modification. Without the capacity for communication between participants, the practice cannot function at all. This passes the removal test of Law 8: the working of collaborative editing collapses, not just its sayability.

Remove trust and delegation stops operating — delegating authority or responsibility requires trusting the delegatee to act on your behalf. Without trust, delegation collapses into micromanagement or refusal to delegate. This passes the removal test of Law 8: the mechanism of delegation ceases to function, not merely its name.

Remove counting and quorum stops operating — a quorum IS a minimum number of participants, and determining whether that number is met requires counting. Without counting, you cannot know if you have a quorum, and the mechanism ceases to function. This passes the removal test of Law 8.

ad-hominem IS a specific kind of logical fallacy — attacking the person making an argument rather than the argument itself. A competent speaker calls it 'a logical fallacy'. Law 9 specific→general. Pinned sense: logical fallacy as a defect in reasoning structure.
equivocation IS a specific kind of logical fallacy — exploiting ambiguous language to mislead. Law 9 specific→general.

burden-of-proof IS a specific kind of standard-of-proof. The standard of proof specifies the degree of evidence required; burden of proof is the particular obligation on a party to meet that standard. A competent legal speaker calls burden of proof 'a standard of proof'. Direction: specific→general.

Topos IS a specific kind of rhetoric — a commonplace or line of argument used in persuasive discourse. In classical rhetoric, topoi are standard argumentative patterns. A competent speaker would call a topos 'a rhetorical device/strategy'. Direction: specific→general. Law 9.

Sophistry needs rhetoric to operate now: it is the deliberate misuse of rhetorical techniques to deceive. Remove rhetoric and sophistry collapses — it has no independent mechanism, only inverted rhetoric. The removal test passes: without rhetorical principles, sophistical arguments cease to function.

A dichotomy IS a specific kind of classification — specifically, a binary division into two mutually exclusive categories. A competent speaker would call a dichotomy 'a classification' (of the two-way variety). Direction: dichotomy → classification (specific → general).

Activism IS a specific kind of dissent — organized, action-oriented disagreement aimed at bringing about change. A competent speaker would categorize activism under dissent. Direction: activism (newer, specific) → dissent (older, general).

A trope IS a specific kind of figure of speech — a word or phrase that carries conventionalized meaning beyond its literal sense (e.g., metaphor, irony, hyperbole). A competent speaker would call a trope 'a figure of speech.' Law 9 — specific→general.

Remove story and narrative-structure stops operating — narrative-structure IS the organization of a story. Without the concept of story, narrative-structure has no domain of application. Law 8: present-tense operating test.

Jurisdiction IS a specific kind of authority — the legitimate scope of power to make decisions and enforce rules. A competent speaker would call jurisdiction a kind (bounded) authority. Direction: jurisdiction (specific) → authority (general).

A topos IS a specific kind of rhetorical device — a conventional argumentative pattern or common-place used in persuasion. A competent speaker would call a topos a rhetorical device for argumentation. Direction: topos (specific) → rhetorical-device (general).

Remove persuasion and topos stops operating — a topos is an argumentative pattern whose entire function is to persuade. Without persuasion as its domain, the topos has no operation. Present-tense dependency.

design-pattern INSTANCE_OF pattern: a design pattern is a specific, documented kind of reusable pattern — a conventional solution to a recurring problem in a specific domain (originally software design, now extended to other fields). A competent speaker would call a design pattern 'a pattern' qualified by domain. Direction: design-pattern (specific) → pattern (general). Which-came-first: pattern is older and more general; design pattern is a domain-specific refinement. Passes Law 9.

jurisprudence INSTANCE_OF philosophy: jurisprudence is a specific branch of philosophy concerned with the nature, foundations, and principles of law. A competent speaker would call jurisprudence 'a philosophy' (of law). Direction: jurisprudence (specific) → philosophy (general). Which-came-first: philosophy is older and more general; jurisprudence is a later specialized domain. Passes Law 9.

Topos are argumentative patterns whose function is to construct sound arguments. Remove logic and a topos loses its reasoning mechanism — it cannot operate as an argumentative pattern without logical structure to give its form. Present-tense dependency (Law 8): the topos needs logic to function.

Jurisprudence as a discipline needs philosophy to operate now — the method of legal reasoning, concepts of justice, and normative analysis all require philosophical thinking. Remove philosophy and jurisprudence cannot function as a field of inquiry.

Counterfactual reasoning requires causal understanding to operate — 'what if X had not happened?' only makes sense when there is a causal model to disrupt. Remove causation and counterfactual thinking collapses into arbitrary speculation.

Remove memory and narrative-structure stops operating — a narrative structure requires memory to persist its elements and connect them across time. Without memory, there is no continuity needed for structure. Present-tense operational dependency.

Remove reasoning and counterfactual stops operating — counterfactual thinking is a mode of reasoning that constructs 'what if' scenarios. Without reasoning, counterfactuals have no mechanism to generate or evaluate alternatives. Present-tense operational dependency.

Jurisprudence exists for the sake of law — its designed purpose is to analyze, interpret, and develop legal principles that further law's operation. The servant (jurisprudence) points at the master (law).

Counterfactual IS a type of reasoning: its definition includes 'suppositional reasoning' as a core parameter. A counterfactual is a cognitive operation that supposes alternatives — it is a specific kind of reasoning process, not merely dependent on it. Direction: specific (counterfactual) → general (reasoning), consistent with Law 9.
Compact IS a type of agreement: its definition states 'a formal agreement between two or more parties.' Specific (compact) → general (agreement), Law 9.

Narrative-structure exists for the sake of storytelling — its designed purpose is to organize and shape narrative communication. The servant (narrative-structure) points at the master (storytelling). Per Law 8d.

Arbitration IS a specific kind of adjudication: a dispute resolution method where a third party renders a binding decision. A competent speaker calls arbitration 'a form of adjudication.' Specific→general per Law 9.

Stories existed first and fed into the concept of narrative-structure. Which-came-first test: the practice of storytelling predates the analytical concept of analyzing how stories are structured. DERIVED_FROM per Law 7.

Topoi (rhetorical strategies/argument frameworks) are designed and maintained for the sake of persuasion. Their entire purpose is to further persuasive communication. Law 8d: the servant (topos) points at the master (persuasion).
Authority needs power to operate — remove the capacity to enforce and authority collapses into mere title. The removal test passes: authority without power is hollow. Law 8.

INSTANCE_OF: taxonomy IS a specific kind of typology — a systematic, hierarchical type-based classification. Direction tested: taxonomy (newer, more specific) → typology (older, more general). A competent speaker would call taxonomy 'a kind of typology.' Law 9.

INSTANCE_OF: standard IS a specific kind of norm — a formally established, measurable norm. Standard points to the general category of norm (specific→general per Law 9). Not age-based: INSTANCE_OF tests 'is X a kind of Y,' not which came first.

A syllabus is designed and maintained for the sake of education — its purpose is to organize and communicate the structure of a course to learners and instructors. Law 8d: servant (syllabus) → master (education). The designed purpose is to further educational operation.

INSTANCE_OF: gossip IS a specific kind of communication — informal information exchange within a social group. Direction tested: specific→general per Law 9. A competent speaker would call gossip 'a form of communication'.

SERVES: canonical works are produced and maintained for the sake of authority — they establish and carry authoritative weight. Law 8d: servant (canonical) → master (authority). Canonical items exist to serve authoritative reference, not the reverse.

SERVES: a worldview is structured for the sake of interpretation — it provides the lens through which events, facts, and experiences are interpreted. Law 8d: the servant (worldview) points to the master (interpretation). Its designed purpose is to organize and make sense of reality.

Remove culture and worldview as a concept stops operating — worldviews are shaped by, draw meaning from, and function within cultural contexts. A worldview without cultural grounding is empty. The removal test passes: worldview needs culture to operate now.

A syllabus IS a specific kind of human-made artifact — a designed document created for institutional purposes. Direction: specific→general per Law 9. A competent speaker would call a syllabus 'an artifact' in the broad sense.

A worldview IS a specific kind of framework — a structured set of assumptions through which reality is interpreted. Direction: specific→general per Law 9. A worldview is a conceptual framework for interpretation.

Direction tested: dead-reckoning IS a specific kind of navigation — a method of determining position by projecting from a known starting point. A competent speaker calls dead-reckoning 'a form of navigation.' Law 9: specific→general.

Direction tested: sunk-cost IS a specific kind of cognitive-bias — the tendency to continue an endeavor due to previously invested resources. A competent speaker calls sunk-cost 'a cognitive bias.' Law 9: specific→general.

Direction tested: conceptual-tool IS a specific kind of cognitive-tool — it is a subset focused on artifacts that structure thought (schemas, models, diagrams). A competent speaker would call a conceptual-tool a cognitive-tool. Law 9: specific→general.
curse IS a specific kind of communication — a performative utterance intended to harm or invoke misfortune. Law 9: specific→general. A competent speaker calls a curse a type of communication act.

speech-act IS a specific kind of communication — an utterance that performs an action (asserting, commanding, promising). Law 9: specific→general. Searle's speech-act theory classifies them as utterance-types that communicate via illocutionary force.

Removal test: remove language and deposition stops operating — a deposition is sworn verbal/written testimony, entirely constituted by language. Law 8: the removal test passes at the object level. Law 2b: this is not meta-level dependency.
bandwagon IS a specific kind of cognitive-bias — the tendency to adopt beliefs or behaviors because many others do. Law 9: specific→general.

curse IS a specific kind of speech-act — a performative utterance (specifically, an imprecating one) that carries illocutionary force. speech-act is the nearest kind: more specific than communication, more precise than act. Law 9: specific→general.

concept-mapping IS a specific kind of knowledge-representation — a diagrammatic method (nodes + labeled edges) for representing semantic relationships among concepts. knowledge-representation is the nearest general kind. Law 9: specific→general.

Estoppel is a specific kind of institutional mechanism — a legal principle that binds a party to their prior representation, functioning as a constraint within legal institutions. Law 9: specific→general. A competent speaker calls estoppel 'an institutional principle'.
Testimony IS a specific kind of speech-act — an assertive utterance made under obligation or authority (legal, scholarly, ceremonial). Speech-act is the nearest general kind.

Direction: deposition IS a specific kind of testimony — sworn testimony given under oath in a legal context before trial. Deposition is a narrower, procedural form of testimony. Testimony is the nearest general kind. Law 9 satisfied.

Removal test: remove precedent (prior judicial decisions as binding authority) and stare-decisis stops operating — stare-decisis is literally the principle of following precedent; without precedent there is nothing to follow. Object-level dependency between two legal concepts, not meta-level.

A legal-principle IS a specific kind of rule — a rule derived from legal reasoning that guides judicial decisions. A competent speaker would call it 'a kind of rule.' Rule is the nearest general kind.

Syllogism IS a specific kind of reasoning — a formal deductive reasoning method with two premises and a conclusion. Direction: reasoning is older and more general (epoch 0.08 vs 0.16); a competent speaker would call a syllogism a kind of reasoning. Reasoning is the nearest general kind.

Remove semiosis (the sign-process of interpretation) and sign stops operating — a sign functions only through interpretation. The removal test confirms: without the process of meaning-making, a sign is merely a physical mark.

A symbol is a convention-based sign whose operation depends entirely on semiosis — the interpretive process that gives it meaning. Remove semiosis and the symbol loses its function as a meaning-carrier.

Situated knowledge is a specific kind of perspective — knowledge that is fundamentally shaped by the social position, context, and standpoint of the knower. A competent speaker would call situated knowledge a kind of perspective on knowledge, not the reverse. Direction: perspective is the general category, situated-knowledge the specific case.

Equity is a specific kind of legal-principle — a principle of fairness and justice that guides legal decision-making, often supplementing or correcting strict legal rules. A competent speaker would call equity a kind of legal principle. Direction: legal-principle is the general category, equity the specific case.
Epistemology existed first as the study of knowledge; situated-knowledge developed within it. Which-came-first: epistemology predates situated-knowledge.

A rumour IS a specific kind of communication — unverified information passed between people. A competent speaker calls a rumour 'a kind of communication.' Per Law 9, INSTANCE_OF to nearest general kind.

A cautionary-tale IS a specific kind of narrative — one structured to warn through depicting negative consequences. The scope explicitly calls it a 'narrative form.' A competent speaker calls it 'a kind of narrative.' Per Law 9.

An interoperability-protocol IS a specific kind of interoperability — a structured set of rules governing how systems exchange information and coordinate. Law 9: specific→general. A competent speaker calls an interoperability-protocol 'a form of interoperability.'

Signifier DEPENDS_ON semiosis — Law 8 removal test: remove semiosis (the interpretive process of meaning-making) and the signifier stops OPERATING. A signifier without semiosis is just marks or sounds — it only functions through interpretation. Object-level dependency, not meta-level about language.

Sophism IS a specific kind of rhetorical-device — a deceptive argumentative technique using plausible but fallacious reasoning. Per Law 9, a competent speaker calls sophism 'a kind of rhetorical device.' Nearest kind: rhetorical-device (not the broader field 'rhetoric').

Amplification IS a specific kind of rhetorical-device. A competent speaker calls amplification 'a rhetorical device.' Direction tested: amplification is the newer, more specific technique; rhetorical-device is the older, more general category. Specific→general per Law 9. Nearest kind: rhetorical-device (not figure-of-speech, since amplification is a technique for emphasis rather than a pattern of figurative wording).

Conjecture as a scientific reasoning operation needs the concept of hypothesis to operate — a conjecture is a tentative claim put forward for testing, and without the framework of hypothesis there is no structured conjecture. Removal test: remove hypothesis and conjecture as a methodological operation collapses into mere guessing.

Praxis as the integration of theory and practice emerged historically from the dialectic between abstract theory and concrete action. Which came first: theory predates praxis as a concept — the term praxis specifically denotes theory put into practice, making theory the older concept that fed into praxis.

A fallacy is a specific kind of argument — specifically, a defective one whose reasoning fails. 'A fallacy IS an argument' is true in the same way a counterfeiture IS money. The filer pins the sense of fallacy as a class of argument (one that appears valid but isn't); argument's accepted definition covers constructed claims with reasoning.

Which-came-first test: logic predates induction as a conceptual framework. Remove logic now — does induction stop operating? Induction is a method of reasoning that operates entirely within the logical framework; without logic, inductive inference has no conceptual apparatus to function. Present-tense dependency (Law 8), not historical.

Remove science now — does falsifiability stop operating? Falsifiability is a criterion for evaluating claims within scientific methodology. Without the concept of science, falsifiability has no domain of operation. It is not a general logical notion but a scientific-epistemic one (Law 8).

Remove reasoning — does retroduction stop operating? Retroduction (abductive inference: inferring the best explanation) IS a form of reasoning. Without the concept of reasoning, retroduction loses its entire function. Law 8 removal test: X ceases to work when Y is removed (Law 8).

Remove reasoning — does conjecture stop operating? A conjecture is a tentative proposition formed through reasoning. Without the concept of reasoning, conjectures collapse into mere guesses with no cognitive operation. The removal test passes (Law 8).

Remove rhetoric — does foil stop operating? A foil is a contrasting element used in argumentation to highlight a position. Without the rhetorical framework, foil loses its argumentative function. In rhetoric, foil operates as a deliberate device of contrast (Law 8).

Falsifiability as a concept requires the logical framework of truth-value testing to operate. Remove logic — the system of reasoning about truth, validity, and testability — and falsifiability ceases to be a meaningful concept. It is not merely historically associated with logic; the concept's entire operation depends on logical structure (propositions, truth conditions, empirical testability).

Induction IS a specific kind of reasoning — inferring general principles from specific observations. A competent speaker calls induction a form of reasoning. This files against the nearest known kind (reasoning); no more specific intermediate kind exists in the graph.
Moving-the-goalposts is a specific kind of rhetorical device — a competent speaker would call it a rhetorical device. Files against the nearest known kind.
A slippery slope is a specific kind of rhetorical device — a competent speaker calls it a rhetorical device. Files against the nearest known kind.

Retroduction (abductive inference: inferring the best explanation from incomplete observations) IS a specific kind of reasoning. A competent speaker would call retroduction a form of reasoning. Files against the nearest known kind. Law 9.

Dialectic IS a specific kind of method — a systematic procedure for examining ideas through dialogue and counter-argument. A competent speaker would call dialectic a method. Files against the nearest known kind. Law 9.

Foil IS a specific kind of rhetorical device — a contrasting element used in argumentation to highlight a position. A competent speaker would call a foil a rhetorical device. Files against the nearest known kind. Law 9.

Foil is designed to serve argumentation — its purpose is to highlight positions within argument by providing contrast. A contrasting element exists for the sake of making arguments clearer and more precise. Law 8d.
Retroduction (abductive inference: inferring the best explanation) is designed to serve diagnosis — its purpose is to explain observed phenomena by inferring their best explanation. Law 8d.

Dialectic's operational mechanism IS linguistic dialogue between parties — remove language and dialectic stops OPERATING, not merely being sayable. The object-level function requires spoken/written exchange. Law 8b: constitutive dependency, not meta-level.

Argumentation's operational mechanism IS structured linguistic exchange — remove language and argumentation stops OPERATING, not merely being sayable. Its method (premises, inference, conclusion articulated in language) requires language constitutively. Law 8b: object-level, not meta.

Abduction (inference to the best explanation) IS a specific kind of reasoning — alongside deduction and induction, a competent speaker would call abduction a form of reasoning. Files against the nearest kind. Law 9.

Deduction (reasoning from general premises to specific conclusions) is a specific kind of reasoning alongside induction and abduction. A competent speaker calls deduction a form of reasoning. Files against the nearest kind per Law 9. No existing edge between these two.

A lens (a particular way of looking at or interpreting something) is a specific kind of perspective. Files against the nearest kind per Law 9. Perspective is the nearest general category — a competent speaker would call a lens a type of perspective or way of seeing.

Availability is a specific kind of property — a measurable quality of systems describing readiness to receive use. Per Law 9, a competent speaker would call availability 'a property.' Files against the nearest accepted kind.

Heuristic IS a specific kind of reasoning — a practical, experience-based method of problem-solving that allows quicker and more efficient decision-making than exhaustive analysis. Law 9: a competent speaker calls a heuristic 'a form of reasoning' or 'a reasoning shortcut'. Files against nearest accepted kind.

Conjecture IS a specific kind of reasoning — tentative proposition formation used to explore possibilities when certainty is unavailable. Law 9: a competent speaker calls conjecture 'a form of reasoning' or 'educated guess'. Files against nearest accepted kind. The DEPENDS_ON edge is misclassified (Law 8c: identity is not dependency).

Idealization IS a specific kind of model — a simplified representation that emphasizes certain features while abstracting away complexity. Law 9: a competent speaker would call an idealization 'a model.' Files against nearest accepted kind.

A lens (a particular way of looking at or interpreting something) is built or maintained for the sake of interpretation. Law 8d: for whose sake? The lens serves the interpretive act. The designed purpose is to further interpretation's operation.

Remove standardization and interoperability stops OPERATING: without shared standards there is no common ground for systems, disciplines, or institutions to interoperate. The removal test passes — interoperability requires standardization as its operating condition (Law 8), not just its history (Law 7).

Remove protocol and interoperability stops OPERATING: interoperability is the capacity of systems to exchange and use information, which requires protocols (rules for exchange) to function. Without protocols there is no mechanism for interoperation. The removal test passes (Law 8).

INSTANCE_OF test: which came first — method or falsification? Method predates falsification by millennia. Falsification IS a specific kind of method — the process of demonstrating that a hypothesis is false by finding contradictory evidence. A competent speaker would call falsification 'a method.' Files against nearest kind.

INSTANCE_OF test: which came first — method or formalism? Method is far older. Formalism IS a specific kind of method — a rigorous approach that uses formal symbols and rules to derive conclusions. A competent speaker would call formalism 'a method.' Files against nearest kind.

Backcasting as a method requires hypothesizing about causal pathways between present actions and future states. Remove hypothesis-formation and backcasting collapses — you can envision a future but cannot identify actionable steps without forming hypotheses about what causes what.

hypothesis as a formal construct derives from the older capacity of abductive inference. Which-came-first test: abduction (epoch 0.12) predates the formal concept of hypothesis (epoch 0.36). Hypothesis formalizes and extends abductive reasoning into a testable claim.

A model requires assumptions to operate — they define what variables matter and how they relate. Remove assumptions and the model cannot produce outputs or predictions; it collapses. The removal test passes.

backcasting as a method requires assumptions to operate — it reasons from a desired future state, which presupposes assumptions about what is possible and how causal pathways work. Remove assumptions and backcasting loses its reasoning mechanism, collapsing from structured method to mere wishful thinking.

A notion is a conceptual entity that depends on the capacity for conceptualization. Remove the process of conceptualization and notions as structured conceptual units cease to exist. The removal test passes at the object level, not the meta-level.

interoperability-protocol depends on the concept of interoperability. The protocol exists to achieve interoperability; remove the underlying concept and the protocol loses all meaning and purpose. Epoch 0.32 vs 0.1 confirms the newer construct depends on the older.

Planning requires notions to operate — constructing plans requires conceptual entities (notions) about future states, goals, and actions. Remove notions and planning collapses: you cannot structure a plan without conceptual units. The removal test passes at the object level.

A grievance is a formal complaint or claim of wrong that is raised to seek redress. It exists for the sake of justice — to bring attention to perceived wrongdoing and trigger corrective mechanisms. The designed purpose is to further justice's operation (Law 8d: for whose sake? grievance→justice).

Law 9: backcasting IS a specific kind of planning method — working backward from a desired future to identify steps. A competent speaker would call backcasting 'a planning method.' Direction: specific→general.

Prompt as a structured instruction requires planning to operate — a prompt without planning is just a request, not a structured directive. Planning provides the scaffolding that makes prompts effective. Removal test: remove planning and structured prompts collapse into unstructured requests.

A prompt frames a scenario — it sets the imagined state that the response should address. Remove scenario and prompts lose their purpose: they no longer evoke a specific context. The prompt is the handle; the scenario is the content it grips.

Backcasting is derived from scenario-building: you start by imagining a future scenario, then work backward. Scenario existed first and fed into the backcasting method. Which-came-first test: scenario-building predates the formalized backcasting technique.

A heuristic is a specific kind of decision-making method: a rule-of-thumb shortcut that enables decisions without full analysis. The which-sense is 'kind of' — a competent speaker calls a heuristic 'a kind of decision-making approach.' Removal test not needed for INSTANCE_OF (Law 9).

In conceptual blending theory (Fauconnier & Turner), a metaphor is a specific kind of conceptual blend: it maps structure from a source domain onto a target domain, forming a blended mental space. A competent speaker in cognitive linguistics calls a metaphor 'a kind of conceptual blend.' Pinned to this sense (Law 11d).

In conceptual blending theory, an analogy is a specific kind of conceptual blend: systematic structure-preserving mapping between domains forming a blended space. A competent speaker in cognitive linguistics calls an analogy 'a kind of conceptual blend.' Pinned to this sense (Law 11d).

Causal reasoning is a specific kind of reasoning — it applies reasoning specifically to cause-effect relationships and causal inference. A competent speaker would call causal reasoning a kind of reasoning. Direction: specific→general per Law 9.

Causal reasoning needs logic to operate now — remove logic and causal reasoning stops working, as it relies on logical inference rules to move from causes to effects. This is object-level dependency, not meta-level sayability.

Isomorphism is a specific kind of model: a structure-preserving correspondence between systems. A competent speaker would say isomorphism is a kind of model. Direction follows Law 9: specific to general.

Pragmatic argument is a specific kind of argument where practical consequences are used as evidence for a claim's truth. A competent speaker would call a pragmatic argument 'an argument.' Law 9: specific→general.

Appeal to authority is a specific kind of logical fallacy where a claim is asserted true based solely on the authority of the source rather than evidence. A competent speaker calls it a fallacy. Law 9: specific→general.

A schema is a specific kind of pattern: a recurring structural arrangement that organizes information. Law 9: specific (schema) → general (pattern). A competent speaker classifies a schema as a pattern.
A scheme is a systematic plan that contains patterned structure in its organization. A scheme cannot be coherent without internal patterns.

Reductionism IS a specific kind of method (Law 9): a method of investigation and explanation that reduces complex systems to simpler, more fundamental components. A competent speaker would call reductionism 'a method.' Pinned sense: method as a systematic procedure for inquiry, matching method's accepted definition.
A scheme is a specific kind of plan — a systematic arrangement designed to achieve a goal. The filer leans on the sense of scheme as structured plan, per the accepted plan definition.
A plan is a specific kind of decision-making output — it structures choices into coordinated action sequences. Instance-of per the nearest-kind ladder.

Choice architecture IS a specific kind of decision-making intervention: the deliberate arrangement of options, defaults, and framing that shapes how decisions are made. A competent speaker classifies choice architecture as a way of structuring decision-making. Specific→general per Law 9.

Prediction operates as a forecasting practice by constructing claims from evidence. Remove evidence from the picture and prediction stops operating as a forecasting practice — it has nothing to build claims upon. The removal test passes: prediction needs evidence running to function.

Planning needs causal reasoning to operate now — a plan coordinates actions toward future outcomes, and without causal reasoning there is no way to predict what actions will produce those outcomes. Remove causal reasoning and planning collapses into guesswork. The removal test passes: planning's operational mechanism IS reasoning about cause-effect to project future states.

Prediction is a specific kind of inference — one that infers future states from current evidence and patterns. Per Law 9, a competent speaker would call prediction 'a form of inference.' The filer leans on this sense.

Choice architecture IS a specific kind of intervention: it is the deliberate arrangement of options, defaults, and framing designed to influence outcomes. Per Law 9, a competent speaker would classify choice architecture as a type of intervention. The filer leans on this sense.

Opportunity cost requires scarcity to operate — the cost of choosing one option is the foregone alternative only when resources are limited. Remove scarcity (make all things abundantly available) and the concept of opportunity cost collapses as meaningless. Present-tense operational dependency, Law 8 test passes.

Conjecture as a reasoning practice needs hypothesis to operate — a conjecture becomes a testable hypothesis only when it articulates a specific, falsifiable prediction. The removal test: remove hypothesis and conjecture loses its operative function in scientific reasoning.

Counterfactual reasoning is a specific kind of reasoning — it evaluates alternative scenarios to draw conclusions. A competent speaker would call it 'a kind of reasoning.' The nearest general kind is 'reasoning' itself; no intermediate rung exists.

Remove causality and mechanism stops operating — mechanism IS the practice of explaining phenomena through cause-effect chains. Without causality, the removal test: mechanism has no explanatory power left. It doesn't merely stop being sayable; its whole mode of working (identifying causal links between parts) collapses.

Causality (epoch 0.01) predates prediction (epoch 0.76). The concept of prediction requires causality — understanding cause-effect relationships is what prediction builds on. Which came first test: causality existed first and fed into the development of prediction.

Thought-experiments need hypothesis to operate — a thought experiment without a hypothesis to test is just daydreaming. The removal test: remove hypothesis and the thought-experiment loses its function of exploring consequences of specific propositions.

Causality predates thought-experiments and fed into them. The practice of thought-experimenting — running mental simulations to explore cause-effect relationships — requires the concept of causality as a prerequisite. Which came first: causality (epoch 0.01) or thought-experiments (epoch 0.30) — causality.

mental-model INSTANCE_OF mental-representation: a mental model is a specific kind of mental representation — a structured representation used to understand, explain, or predict how something works. A competent speaker would call a mental model 'a kind of mental representation.' Nearest general kind is mental-representation.

schema-theory INSTANCE_OF theory: schema theory is a specific kind of theory about how knowledge is organized in structured frameworks called schemas. A competent speaker would call it 'a kind of theory.' Nearest general kind is theory itself.

epistemic-violence DEPENDS_ON knowledge: epistemic violence is harm inflicted through knowledge-related channels (silencing, discrediting, destroying epistemic capacity). Remove knowledge — the very medium through which this violence operates — and epistemic violence ceases to function. This is a constitutive dependency per Law 8, not mere association.

Inference (drawing conclusions from evidence) predates explanation as an organized practice. Explanation builds on inference: you cannot explain without inferring, and the concept of inference (as a reasoning operation) is more foundational and older. Epoch check: inference=0.08, explanation=0.12 — inference is older and fed into the development of explanation practices.

Explanation operates through models: to explain is to present a model that makes phenomena intelligible. Remove models and explanation ceases to function — there is no structure through which explanations operate. The removal test: without models, explanations have no architecture (no premises, no structure, no mapping from cause to effect).

Script-theory IS a specific kind of schema-theory: scripts are event schemas — structured representations of recurring situations. A competent speaker would call script-theory 'a kind of schema theory.' Nearest general is schema-theory (no intermediate kind).

Remove memory and mental models stop operating: mental models are representations stored in memory. The removal test: without memory there are no mental models to form, maintain, or access. Not a meta-level naming claim — this is object-level dependency on the mechanism of memory.

Planning DEPENDS_ON sense-making: to plan is to act in a situation, and sense-making provides the situated understanding of that situation. The removal test: remove sense-making (the retrospective/ongoing construction of meaning from events) and planning stops operating — you cannot plan without first making sense of the context. This is not meta-level (Law 2b); it is an object-level dependency between two cognitive practices.

Theory of mind IS a specific kind of cognitive model: it is a model for representing and reasoning about others' mental states. A competent speaker calls theory of mind 'a cognitive model.' Nearest general is cognitive-model.

Sense-making as a structured practice depends on language: to make sense is to categorize, narrate, and articulate understanding through linguistic resources. Remove language and sense-making as practiced collapses — it cannot operate without the symbols and categories that language provides. This is object-level, not meta-level: the practice itself is linguistic in nature.

Removal test: remove knowledge (systems, practices, communities) and epistemic violence has nothing to act upon — it is defined as harm to someone's capacity as a knower. Without knowledge frameworks, the phenomenon collapses. The filer argues a genuine operating dependency, not mere association.

Modeling IS a specific kind of representation: a model is a representation of some target domain. A competent speaker classifies modeling as a type of representation. The note pins the sense of modeling as the representational artifact rather than the process.

Theory of mind requires representational capacity to operate: ToM is the ability to represent others' mental states. Remove representational capacity and ToM has no mechanism to function — it collapses entirely. Epoch check confirms representation (0) predates theory-of-mind (0.78), consistent with a dependency direction.

Analogy operates by recognizing structural correspondences (isomorphisms) between domains. Remove the concept of isomorphism/structural correspondence and analogy has no mechanism to function — it collapses. Direction: analogy is newer (0.12) than isomorphism (0.04).

Interoperability requires communication to operate: the capacity of systems to work together depends on information exchange. Remove communication and interoperability has no mechanism to function — systems cannot coordinate without it. Epoch confirms communication (0.08) predates interoperability (0.1).

Sense-making IS a specific kind of cognition: it is the process of constructing meaning from experience and information. A competent speaker would classify it as a type of cognition. This is INSTANCE_OF, not DEPENDS_ON — sense-making is not merely using cognition, it IS cognition in action. Nearest general target.

Folk psychology existed long before theory of mind as a formal concept. Folk psychology — our everyday capacity for attributing mental states to others — is the pre-scientific predecessor that fed into the academic concept of theory of mind (which emerged in cognitive science in the 1970s-80s). Which-came-first test: folk psychology came first.

Interoperability IS the capacity of systems to work together through shared rules. Remove protocols and interoperability has no mechanism — systems cannot coordinate without shared conventions. This passes Law 8 removal test: without protocols, interoperability stops operating entirely.

A template is a pattern made reusable. Remove pattern and template has no mechanism — it is pattern as applied to repeated contexts. Law 8 removal test passes: without the concept of pattern, a template is an empty label.
Epistemic violence operates through power asymmetry — it is the harm done to someone capacity as a knower by another dominance. The removal test: remove power and epistemic violence stops operating.

Dogma IS a specific kind of orthodoxy — a type of accepted authoritative doctrine that claims absolute truth. A competent speaker would classify dogma as a kind of orthodoxy (Law 9). The note pins INSTANCE_OF: dogma as a specific authoritative form of orthodoxy.

Prompt engineering depends on prompt to operate: it is the practice of designing and optimizing prompts. Remove prompt (the artifact being engineered) and prompt engineering has nothing to work on — it ceases to operate. Genuine Law 8 removal test, not meta-level.

Remove belief and a talisman is just an object — it ceases to operate AS a talisman. The power of a talisman lies in its perceived efficacy, which requires belief. This passes the Law 8 removal test: belief is not merely sayability; it is the operational mechanism by which talismans function.
Refutation IS a specific kind of argumentation — one aimed at disproving a claim. A competent speaker calls refutation 'a kind of argumentation' (Law 9). The note pins INSTANCE_OF sense.
